items.promptZh:
[BRAND NAME = 更改为你的品牌]。

扮演社交媒体艺术总监和数字拼贴艺术家，专为 Instagram 和数字营销活动创作大胆、面向年轻人的品牌内容。阶段 1：概念框架 创建一个充满动感的数字拼贴，将时尚摄影与平面设计式的混乱融合在一起。这是受控的反叛——一种感觉自发且充满活力，同时保持品牌一致性的构图。美学是反精致的：撕裂边缘、 layered 纹理、手绘元素和大胆色块，强烈传达自信与动感。阶段 2：模特与摄影 - 主体：一位模特（多元选角，年龄 18-30 岁），处于动感、自信的姿势 - 姿势能量：80% 态度，20% 自然——坐着、跳跃、运动中或强势站姿（避免静态站立） - 服装：符合 [BRAND NAME] 美学的街头风格/运动休闲风——休闲但有造型 - 主打产品：突出展示 1 款标志性 [BRAND NAME] 产品（运动鞋、包、服装）——这是视觉锚点 - 摄影风格：编辑时尚抠图——模特从背景中提取，边缘干净 - 相机角度：轻微低角度以增强主体力量感（英雄视角） - 裁剪：全身或 3/4 身，清晰展示主打产品 - 背景移除：干净抠出模特，以便叠加到拼贴元素上 阶段 3：色块基础 - 主色块：大型有机形状（占构图 40-60%），使用大胆、饱和的品牌色，位于模特后方/周围 - 形状风格：不规则、手绘美学——想象 Photoshop 笔刷笔触或撕纸纹理（不是完美几何形状） - 颜色选择（自主）：从 [BRAND NAME] 调色板中选择 1 种主色： - 纹理：可见笔刷笔触、颗粒或细微噪点（15-25% 不透明度）——避免扁平数字填充 - 位置：色块用于框住模特，但不遮挡关键产品细节 阶段 4：图形元素层 在构图中散布添加 3-5 个抽象图形元素： - 元素类型： - 调色板：总共使用 2-3 种强调色（主色块颜色 + 来自品牌调色板的 1-2 种对比色调） - 位置：不对称散布——主要位于左上和右下区域（避免中心拥挤） - 比例：混合小型（画布 5%）和中型（画布 15%）元素——不要有过分抢眼的元素 - 美学：模拟/手工感——不完美圆形、粗糙边缘、可见纹理 阶段 5：字体整合 - 品牌标志：干净的 [BRAND NAME] 标志放置于左上或右上象限（宽度的 10-15%） - 口号/标语：如果 [BRAND NAME] 有标志性口号，请使用以下方式整合： - 辅助文案：可选 1 行描述（例如“A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE”），使用较小的全大写无衬线字体 - 字体处理：混合对齐和轻微旋转文字（2-5° 角度）以营造动态能量 - 层级：标志最大 → 口号中等 → 文案最小 阶段 6：纹理与背景 - 基础层：灰白色或浅灰色纹理背景（不是纯白） - 纹理选项（自主选择）： - 颜色：RGB 245-250（偏暖的近白色）——保持明亮同时增加深度 - 处理：纹理应被感受到，而不是被明显看到——增强触感而不与前景竞争 阶段 7：构图规则 - 布局：不对称平衡——模特偏离中心，图形元素进行反平衡 - 留白：15-20% 负空间（可见纹理背景），以防止局促感 - 图层顺序：背景纹理 → 色块 → 图形元素 → 模特（抠图）→ 字体顶层 - 焦点：模特 + 主打产品 = 主要焦点（60% 视觉权重），图形支持（40%） - 动势：对角线和倾斜元素创造方向流动（左上到右下或反之） 阶段 8：品牌智能（自主） 根据 [BRAND NAME] 个性自主调整构图： - 街头服饰/运动服饰（Nike、Adidas、Supreme）： - 奢华街头服饰（Balenciaga、Off-White、Gucci）： - 美妆/生活方式（Glossier、Fenty、Skims）： - 科技/现代（Apple、Tesla、Beats）： 阶段 9：社交媒体页脚（可选） - 底部条带：底部 8-10% 画面使用干净白色或浅灰色条 - 内容：社交媒体账号（Instagram、Facebook、Twitter），使用小号无衬线字体 - 布局：三列网格，带平台图标或文字账号 - 美学：极简且专业——与上方混乱拼贴形成对比 技术规格： - 宽高比：4:5（Instagram 信息流）或 1:1（方形社交帖子） - 分辨率：最低 2400x3000px（高质量，适合缩放和细节） - 色彩模式：sRGB，鲜艳饱和度（针对 Instagram 优化） - 文件美学：模拟手工质感的数字拼贴（Photoshop + 手绘混合） - 模特摄影：85mm 镜头，f/2.8，原始拍摄时浅景深（抠图前） - 风格参考：Nike 社交营销活动、Spotify Wrapped 图形、Z 世代 Instagram 美学、Hypebeast x 街头服饰联名 - 情绪：自信、充满活力、年轻、真实的混乱、反企业式精致
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME = CHANGE TO YOUR BRAND]. 
Act as a Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, youth-oriented brand content for Instagram and digital campaigns. PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK Create a dynamic digital collage that merges fashion photography with graphic design chaos. This is controlled rebellion – a composition that feels spontaneous and energetic while maintaining brand coherence. The aesthetic is anti-polished: torn edges, layered textures, hand-drawn elements, and bold color blocking that screams confidence and movement. PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY - Subject: One model (diverse casting, age 18-30) in a dynamic, confident pose - Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural – sitting, jumping, mid-motion, or power stance (avoid static standing) - Outfit: Street style/athleisure that aligns with [BRAND NAME] aesthetic – casual but styled - Hero Product: Feature 1 signature [BRAND NAME] product prominently (sneakers, bag, apparel) – this is the visual anchor - Photography Style: Editorial fashion cutout – model extracted from background with clean edges - Camera Angle: Slight low angle to empower subject (hero perspective) - Crop: Full body or 3/4 body showing hero product clearly - Background Removal: Model cut out cleanly for layering over collage elements PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION - Primary Color Blob: Large organic shape (40-60% of composition) in bold, saturated brand color behind/around model - Shape Style: Irregular, hand-painted aesthetic – think Photoshop brush strokes or torn paper texture (NOT perfect geometric shapes) - Color Selection (Autonomous): Choose 1 hero color from [BRAND NAME] palette: - Texture: Visible brush strokes, grain, or subtle noise (15-25% opacity) – avoid flat digital fills - Placement: Blob positioned to frame model without obscuring key product details PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER Add 3-5 abstract graphic elements scattered across composition: - Element Types: - Color Palette: Use 2-3 accent colors total (main blob color + 1-2 contrasting tones from brand palette) - Placement: Asymmetric scatter – top-left and bottom-right zones primarily (avoid center crowding) - Scale: Mix small (5% of canvas) and medium (15% of canvas) elements – nothing overpowering - Aesthetic: Analog/handmade feel – imperfect circles, rough edges, visible texture PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION - Brand Logo: Clean [BRAND NAME] logo placed in upper-left or upper-right quadrant (10-15% of width) - Slogan/Tagline: If [BRAND NAME] has an iconic slogan, integrate it using: - Supporting Copy: Optional 1-line descriptor (e.g., "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE") in smaller uppercase sans-serif - Type Treatment: Mix of aligned and slightly rotated text (2-5° angles) for dynamic energy - Hierarchy: Logo largest → Slogan medium → Copy smallest PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND - Base Layer: Off-white or light gray textured background (NOT pure white) - Texture Options (Autonomous selection): - Color: RGB 245-250 (near-white with warmth) – maintains brightness while adding depth - Treatment: Texture should be felt, not seen – enhances tactility without competing with foreground PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES - Layout: Asymmetric balance – model off-center, graphic elements counter-balance - Breathing Room: 15-20% negative space (textured background visible) to prevent claustrophobia - Layering Order: Background texture → Color blob → Graphic elements → Model (cutout) → Typography top layer - Focal Point: Model + hero product = primary focus (60% visual weight), graphics support (40%) - Movement: Diagonal lines and angled elements create directional flow (top-left to bottom-right or vice versa) PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTONOMOUS) Autonomously adapt composition based on [BRAND NAME] personality: - Streetwear/Sportswear (Nike, Adidas, Supreme): - Luxury Streetwear (Balenciaga, Off-White, Gucci): - Beauty/Lifestyle (Glossier, Fenty, Skims): - Tech/Modern (Apple, Tesla, Beats): PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL) - Bottom Strip: Clean white or light gray bar at bottom 8-10% of frame - Content: Social media handles (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) in small sans-serif - Layout: Three-column grid with platform icons or text handles - Aesthetic: Minimal and professional – contrast with chaotic collage above TECHNICAL SPECS: - Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram feed) or 1:1 (square social post) - Resolution: 2400x3000px minimum (high-quality for zoom and detail) - Color Mode: sRGB, vibrant saturation (Instagram-optimized) - File Aesthetic: Digital collage that mimics analog craft (Photoshop + hand-drawn hybrid) - Model Photography: 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field on original shoot (before cutout) - Style Reference: Nike social campaigns, Spotify wrapped graphics, Gen Z Instagram aesthetics, Hypebeast x streetwear collabs - Mood: Confident, energetic, youthful, authentic chaos, anti-corporate polish

items.title: 日系日常抓拍镂空上衣
items.titleZh: 日系日常抓拍镂空上衣
items.promptZh:
超写实智能手机摄影风格图像，竖幅3:4构图，融合高端时尚杂志摄影与真实日常生活方式记录。画面捕捉一位虚构的成年日本女性在朋友随手举起智能手机为她拍照的准确瞬间，她正要弯腰去捡放在地板上的一件轻薄开衫。图像定格在动作开始之前，她的上半身自然扭转。她没有摆姿势，也没有意识到自己正在被拍摄。整体应像是一个私人的日常瞬间被偶然保存在手机相册中，而不是商业时尚广告或影棚肖像。

视觉焦点不是人物肖像，而是从领口到腹部合身灰米色多层镂空上衣的结构、面料的张力，以及织物与皮肤相接处形成的细腻阴影。

温暖安静的室内氛围，像准备出门时的一个随意瞬间。低饱和度色彩，柔和中性色调，自然手机快照感。避免目录式摄影、奢华影棚造型或摆拍时尚姿势。

模特是一位虚构的25岁以上成年日本女性，与任何真实人物或名人都不相似。她拥有健康、自然匀称的女性身材和真实沙漏型轮廓。她拥有自然丰满、圆润的胸部，呈现约I罩杯的视觉效果，同时保持真实人体比例而不过度夸张。她的女性曲线通过服装贴合、面料张力和真实身体结构自然呈现，而不是通过刻意强调的姿势。

她的脸、眼睛、鼻子和嘴几乎完全在画面之外。看不到下巴。没有与镜头的眼神接触。只可见颈根以及少量延伸到画面外的头发。

她留着深棕色长发。大部分头发保持在构图之外，只有几缕发丝自然垂在脖子和肩膀左侧旁边。发型不应看起来过度整理。几缕松散发丝应因动作而显得略微移位。

构图只捕捉从颈根向下到肚脐稍下方及上髋部区域的画面。手臂、腿和头部保持在画面之外。躯干轴线从左上方到右下方斜向倾斜约25度。一侧肩膀略微向后拉，而对侧腰部更靠近镜头。由于她在动作中转移重心，从胸部到腹部的过渡形成自然的不对称S形曲线。腹部不应过度拱起。

皮肤呈暖浅米色调，带有细微黄色和粉色底色。胸部、侧腰和腹部仍可见自然肤色变化和细腻皮肤纹理。皮肤呈柔和哑光外观，没有油光。镂空边缘和针织带在皮肤上形成细腻连续的阴影，使立体形态通过真实光线与面料互动自然显现。

她穿着一件低饱和度浅灰米色、暖灰褐色和柔米灰色的合身无袖短款上衣。服装具有宽边式高领和贴身廓形。面料是类似人造丝聚酯混纺的薄哑光弹力针织布，带有细微针织纹理。

上衣紧密贴合自然身体形状，并具有从领口延伸到腹部的连续多层镂空结构。镂空不是简单的水平线。它们是细长叶形和杏仁形开口，中部略宽，两端更尖。上胸部区域包含相对较大的镂空，而开口向腹部逐渐变小、变窄、变短。左右两侧根据身体扭转自然拉伸不同，形成真实的不对称。

可见皮肤面积应最大化，同时仍保持可信的可穿着服装结构。面料保持不透明并适当覆盖必要区域，避免意外暴露。

镂空结构包括锁骨下方一个小水平狭缝、上胸部区域多个较大的叶形开口，以及腹部多个窄长开口。开口外侧逐渐变宽，而中央尖端直接连接到针织蕾丝结构中。服装不应完全对称。受身体旋转影响的一侧看起来略微压缩，而更靠近镜头的一侧看起来略微拉伸。

一条相配的柔软管状带，宽约8–12毫米，通过服装中央连接镂空边缘。不是简单的束身衣式鞋带设计，该结构形成纵向重复的X形交叉和细长菱形图案。每个交叉处形成小结和纵向编织细节。上部有较大的编织图案，向腹部逐渐变得更精细。带子具有真实张力，间距和角度有细微不规则。

面料表现应真实。胸部周围，弹力面料自然向两个方向拉伸，使叶形开口沿身体曲线略微扩张。中央编织带承受轻柔张力，并在下方形成连续柔和阴影。腹部区域张力略微降低，带有细微水平和斜向皱纹。侧面面料自然包裹身体，一小部分下摆离皮肤几毫米悬浮。

只佩戴一条非常细的金链项链。它在脖子左侧和锁骨区域部分可见，一部分消失在镂空结构后面。没有大吊坠、耳环、手表或其他配饰。

背景是普通室内生活空间，墙面为白色到暖灰色。轻微墙面纹理、柔和阴影和小型日常细节仍可见。人物占据画面的大部分，边缘周围只可见小面积背景。背景物品如编织篮、纸袋或小件家居物品可能隐约出现，但不应吸引注意力。

使用智能手机标准广角相机，类似iPhone 16 Pro或iPhone 17 Pro原生相机。竖幅手持拍摄，等效约26mm镜头。相机距离主体约40–55cm，位于胸部高度或稍高，略从左前角度拍摄。对焦在服装中央编织结构上，同时保持胸部到腹部区域自然清晰。不要制造强烈背景虚化。

柔和自然窗光从左上进入，混合微弱暖色室内光源。光线漫射柔和，中低对比度。编织带和镂空边缘下方出现纤细阴影。颈部区域因头发阴影而略微变暗。避免强闪光、硬聚光灯或影棚灯光。

图像应具有真实智能手机照片特征：低饱和度、略暖白平衡、细微JPEG压缩、轻微高光溢出、暗部有极弱亮度噪点，以及自然手持拍摄瑕疵。避免过度HDR、电影调色、强烈暗角或重度胶片效果。

加入真实瑕疵：相机顺时针倾斜约3度，镂空、编织细节、肩高和服装下摆位置有细微不对称。一两缕头发可能自然重叠在衣物上。面料应保留因张力产生的小皱纹。图像边缘可能显示轻微广角镜头畸变。发梢可能包含极少量运动模糊。

构图：竖幅3:4画幅。将颈部区域稍微放在左上方，腹部区域放在右下方。中央编织结构在画面中形成一条对角线视觉引导线。保持脸、手臂和腿完全在构图之外。视觉焦点应保持在面料与皮肤的边界、服装结构以及身体的真实动作上。
items.prompt:
A hyper-realistic smartphone photography style image, vertical 3:4 composition, combining high-end fashion editorial photography with authentic everyday lifestyle documentation. A fictional adult Japanese woman is captured at the exact moment when a friend casually raises a smartphone and photographs her just before she bends down to pick up a lightweight cardigan placed on the floor. The image captures the instant before the movement begins, with her upper body naturally twisting. She is not posing and is unaware of being photographed. It should feel like a private everyday moment accidentally preserved in a phone gallery, not a commercial fashion advertisement or studio portrait.

The visual focus is not a character portrait, but the construction of the fitted greige multi-layer cutout top from the neckline to the abdomen, the tension of the fabric, and the delicate shadows created where the textile meets the skin.

Warm and quiet indoor atmosphere, like a casual moment while getting ready to go out. Low-saturation color palette, soft neutral tones, natural smartphone snapshot feeling. Avoid catalog photography, luxury studio styling, or staged fashion posing.

The model is a fictional adult Japanese woman over 25 years old, with no resemblance to any real person or celebrity. She has a healthy, naturally proportioned feminine figure with a realistic hourglass silhouette. She has naturally full, rounded breasts with an approximately I-cup visual effect, while maintaining realistic human proportions without exaggeration. Her feminine curves are naturally expressed through the fit of the clothing, fabric tension, and realistic body structure rather than a deliberately emphasized pose.

Her face, eyes, nose, and mouth are almost completely outside the frame. No chin is visible. No eye contact with the camera. Only the base of her neck and a small amount of hair extending beyond the frame are visible.

She has long dark brown hair. Most of the hair remains outside the composition, with only a few strands naturally falling beside the left side of her neck and shoulder. The hairstyle should not look overly arranged. A few loose strands should appear slightly displaced by movement.

The framing captures only the area from the base of the neck down to slightly below the navel and the upper hip area. Arms, legs, and head remain outside the frame. The torso axis tilts diagonally from upper left to lower right by approximately 25 degrees. One shoulder is slightly pulled backward, while the opposite waist moves closer to the camera. Because she is shifting her weight during movement, the transition from chest to abdomen creates a natural asymmetrical S-shaped curve. The abdomen should not be excessively arched.

The skin has a warm light beige tone with subtle yellow and pink undertones. Natural variations in skin color and fine skin texture remain visible across the chest, side waist, and abdomen. The skin has a soft matte appearance without oily shine. The cutout edges and knitted straps create delicate continuous shadows on the skin, allowing the three-dimensional form to appear naturally through realistic light and fabric interaction.

She wears a low-saturation light greige, warm taupe, and soft beige-gray fitted sleeveless cropped top. The garment features a wide band-style high neckline and a close-fitting silhouette. The fabric is a thin matte stretch jersey similar to a rayon-polyester blend, with subtle micro-knit texture.

The top tightly follows the natural body shape and features a continuous multi-layer cutout structure extending from the neckline to the abdomen. The cutouts are not simple horizontal lines. They are elongated leaf-shaped and almond-shaped openings, slightly wider in the center and sharper toward both ends. The upper chest area contains relatively larger cutouts, while the openings gradually become smaller, narrower, and shorter toward the abdomen. The left and right sides are naturally stretched differently according to the body twist, creating realistic asymmetry.

The visible skin area should be maximized while still maintaining a believable wearable garment structure. The fabric remains opaque and properly covers necessary areas, avoiding accidental exposure.

The cutout structure includes a small horizontal slit below the collarbone, multiple larger leaf-shaped openings across the upper chest area, and several narrow elongated openings across the abdomen. The outer sides of the openings gradually widen, while the central tips connect directly into the knitted lace structure. The garment should not be perfectly symmetrical. The side affected by body rotation appears slightly compressed, while the side closer to the camera appears slightly extended.

A matching soft tubular strap, approximately 8–12mm wide, connects the edges of the cutouts through the center of the garment. Instead of a simple corset-style shoelace design, the structure forms repeated X-shaped crossings and elongated diamond patterns vertically. Each intersection creates small knots and vertical woven details. The upper section has larger woven patterns, gradually becoming finer toward the abdomen. The straps have realistic tension, with subtle irregularities in spacing and angles.

The fabric behavior should be realistic. Around the chest area, the stretch fabric pulls naturally in both directions, causing the leaf-shaped openings to expand slightly along the body curve. The central woven straps carry gentle tension and create continuous soft shadows underneath. The abdomen area has slightly reduced tension with subtle horizontal and diagonal wrinkles. The side fabric naturally wraps around the body, with a small part of the hem floating a few millimeters away from the skin.

Only a very thin gold chain necklace is worn. It is partially visible around the left side of the neck and collarbone area, with part of it disappearing behind the cutout structure. No large pendant, earrings, watch, or other accessories.

The background is an ordinary indoor living space with white to warm gray walls. Slight wall texture, soft shadows, and small everyday details remain visible. The person occupies approximately most of the frame, with only small areas of background visible around the edges. Background objects such as a woven basket, paper bag, or small household item may appear subtly, but they should not attract attention.

Use a smartphone standard wide-angle camera, similar to an iPhone 16 Pro or iPhone 17 Pro native camera. Vertical handheld photography, equivalent to approximately 26mm lens. The camera is about 40–55cm from the subject, positioned around chest height or slightly higher, slightly from the left front angle. Focus on the central woven structure of the garment while keeping the chest-to-abdomen area naturally sharp. Do not create strong background blur.

Soft natural window light enters from the upper left, mixed with a weak warm indoor light source. The lighting is diffused and gentle, with medium-low contrast. Thin shadows appear beneath the woven straps and cutout edges. The neck area becomes slightly darker due to hair shadow. Avoid strong flash, hard spotlight, or studio lighting.

The image should have realistic smartphone photo characteristics: low saturation, slightly warm white balance, subtle JPEG compression, mild highlight clipping, very weak brightness noise in darker areas, and natural handheld imperfections. Avoid excessive HDR, cinematic color grading, strong vignette, or heavy film effects.

Add realistic imperfections: slight clockwise camera tilt of around 3 degrees, subtle asymmetry in the cutouts, woven details, shoulder height, and garment hem position. One or two strands of hair may overlap the clothing naturally. The fabric should retain small wrinkles caused by tension. The image edges may show slight wide-angle lens distortion. The hair tips may contain a tiny amount of motion blur.

Composition: vertical 3:4 frame. Place the neck area slightly toward the upper left and the abdomen area toward the lower right. The central woven structure creates a diagonal visual line through the frame. Keep the face, arms, and legs completely outside the composition. The visual focus should remain on the boundary between fabric and skin, the garment construction, and the realistic movement of the body.

【核心目标】设计一个真正可用于餐饮品牌的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」。以中文主字标为核心，融合强识别图形、餐饮品类符号、复古中英文排版和完整徽章式结构，打造具有门头感、包装感、品牌系统感和传播感的餐饮 Logo。

最终结果应让人一眼感受到：1) 这是一个餐饮品牌；2) 它有明确品类和个性；3) 它像一个成熟的品牌主标，而不是一张装饰性图案。

【设计本质】五层整合：中文主字标（识别）+ 图形符号（记忆点）+ 徽章结构（完整性）+ 中英文排版（层次）+ 颜色系统（品类情绪）。

【最重要的原则】1) 中文品牌名必须醒目、清楚、具有招牌感；2) Logo 必须是一个完整标识，而不是零散元素拼贴；3) 图形必须与品牌名或品类相关；4) 英文为辅助，中文为主；5) 整体必须有餐饮品牌属性，适合门头、菜单、包装和社媒头像；6) 必须有复古感但不能老气脏乱；7) 必须有「国潮复古餐饮徽章」的味道。

【中文主字标】字体厚重粗壮，有黑体 / 宋黑 / 商业手写感，清晰可读，有门头感。

【图形系统】根据核心图形与品类设计相关主图形：动物神兽（龙凤虎牛鹅鱼蛙鹤）/ 食材菜品（龙虾烧鹅牛肉面碗火焰茶杯）/ 传统图腾（章印纹样牌匾）/ 器具场景（烤架火焰碗筷冰室元素）。要有记忆点，偏复古插画 / 版画感 / 老商标感 / 国潮线描感。

【徽章结构】完整餐饮品牌徽章而非简单横排：上方英文拱形+中央图形+下方中文主字标；圆章 / 椭圆章 / 牌匾式构图；对称排版+小图章+小圆标系统；老招牌 / 老商标 / 包装主标式版式。

【中英文排版】中文为主英文为辅。英文可用：HOUSE / TAVERN / BARBECUE / ROAST GOOSE / TEA RESTAURANT / LOBSTER HOUSE / ESTD / SINCE / CLASSIC / SPECIALTY。

【辅助元素】ESTD年份、小圆章、小图标、小标签、小印章、地域说明、品类说明、横线点阵小边框、slogan 小字（克制使用）。

【色彩】按品类选择：黑+红（烧烤卤味烧味）/ 黑+金棕金（老字号熟食烧鹅粤式）/ 绿+红+米白（港式冰室茶餐厅）/ 蓝+红+白（海鲜龙虾年轻夜宵）/ 黑+蓝（年轻夜宵酒馆）/ 红+米白（老长沙粉面传统小吃）。2-4 个主色最稳。

【画面呈现】独立 Logo 展示图非菜单海报；背景浅灰白 / 米白 / 纸白；Logo 主体居中清晰；整体看起来像成熟餐饮品牌主 Logo 提案。

【风格关键词】国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo、Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo、餐饮品牌、复古商标、老招牌、品牌徽章、中英混排、国潮字标、餐饮主标、门头感、包装感、老字号感、新消费餐饮。

【输出】一个高完成度的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」，以中文品牌名为核心，结合复古图形、中英文辅助系统、徽章式构图和明确的品类属性，形成真正可品牌化、可传播、可落地的餐饮品牌标识。

Well lived-in bedroom, cozy but not messy and not cluttered. Bed with soft rumpled sheets, wooden dresser, mirror, lamp, small wall art, plant, warm natural indoor light, realistic everyday room details.

iPhone 17 Pro natural HDR, crisp skin texture, sharp face-paint linework, realistic smartphone depth, no beauty filter, no DSLR blur, no cinematic grading.

items.title: Toy-camera vanity bedroom candid
items.prompt:
Create image: use the attached image.

A candid late-night bedroom memory captured while getting ready in front of an old wooden vanity. The subject kneels casually beside the dressing table while absentmindedly holding a large makeup brush near her lips, caught somewhere between finishing her makeup and daydreaming. Her expression feels distant, sleepy, slightly melancholic, and completely unaware of the camera. Short dark bob hair frames her face naturally with slight movement and imperfect strands.

She wears a black sequined backless bodysuit, simple earrings, and minimal accessories. The atmosphere feels intimate, personal, and slightly chaotic rather than glamorous.

The room feels old and lived-in. A vintage wooden vanity with curved mirrors sits against patterned wallpaper. Small cosmetics, perfume bottles, hair accessories, scattered makeup items, magazines, and random bedroom clutter cover the tabletop. Dim corners, worn furniture, and everyday objects blend into the background.

The photographer was not trying to create a beautiful image. The photograph feels accidental, poorly composed, and taken without preparation. The shutter was pressed unexpectedly during a quiet moment. The framing feels careless and slightly wrong, like a forgotten photo discovered years later.

Subject occupies approximately 70–80% of the frame while remaining noticeably off-center. Negative space appears primarily on one side through the vanity mirrors, wallpaper, and surrounding room details. Headroom remains approximately 15–20%. Parts of the vanity, mirror frame, dress, knees, and tabletop objects are awkwardly clipped by the frame edges.

Snapshot captured on a cheap 2000s low-resolution toy digital camera. Heavy motion blur, slight camera shake, crooked framing, accidental composition, harsh direct pop-up flash creating dirty hotspots and uneven exposure, muddy shadows, faded low-fidelity colors, intense digital noise, heavy sensor grain, chromatic aberration, thick plastic toy-lens softness, focus miss, JPEG compression damage, motion smear, and 0.3-megapixel quality.

Strong warm light leak contamination spreads naturally through part of the frame. Bright areas bloom excessively. The toy camera struggles to resolve detail. Facial features remain recognizable but softened by blur, compression, focus failure, and low-resolution sensor limitations. Hair strands merge together. Makeup items, wallpaper patterns, mirror reflections, furniture details, and fabric textures lose definition and become smeared.

The image resembles a forgotten Friendster-era bedroom photo repeatedly uploaded, downloaded, and re-saved over many years. Visible JPEG artifacts, scan-like grain, dust specks, scratches, faded print texture, worn image quality, dirty flash reflections, and file degradation affect the entire image.

Do not preserve modern beauty-photo clarity.

Do not protect facial sharpness.

The subject remains recognizable despite image degradation.

The photograph prioritizes memory over aesthetics.

items.title: Sony Alpha 7CR sketchbook study
items.prompt:
Create a highly detailed industrial design concept sketch on an off-white lined notebook page featuring the SONY Alpha 7CR camera as the main subject. The page should resemble a real camera designer’s brainstorming notebook, with a large three-quarter perspective hand-drawn illustration of the Sony Alpha 7CR as the dominant centerpiece. The camera must be instantly recognizable: compact full-frame mirrorless body, clean rectangular silhouette with softened edges, prominent lens mount, textured grip, EVF corner placement, minimalist Sony control layout, precise top dials, shutter button position, articulated-screen structure hints, and premium Alpha-series industrial design language.

Render the main sketch using black ballpoint pen linework, ultra-fine cross-hatching, product-design construction lines, perspective guides, and carefully placed colored marker accents. Use restrained Sony-inspired accents such as matte black, graphite gray, subtle silver highlights, and a small touch of muted orange on the lens mount marker area, while keeping most of the rendering in elegant pen-sketch form. The hero camera should feel like a professional industrial design study for a premium compact full-frame camera.

Add handwritten annotations, arrows, and design callouts pointing to key features such as:
“Compact Full-Frame Body”
“Alpha Ergonomic Grip”
“High-Resolution Sensor Core”
“Minimal Control Layout”
“Corner EVF Placement”
“Precision Dial Geometry”
“Lens Mount Proportion”
“Textured Grip Surface”
“Portable Pro Camera Form”
“Rear Screen Integration”

Include tiny doodle illustrations and rough concept thumbnails scattered naturally across the page, such as miniature front / side / top-view camera studies, grip shape explorations, lens mount detail sketches, top-dial and button-layout studies, hot shoe and EVF silhouette notes, rear-screen hinge concept doodles, tiny lens pairing thumbnails, small photographer-in-use stick sketch, quick street-photography mood thumbnails, interface and menu-layout micro-notes, and compact travel-carry concept sketches.

Place a small reference image of the actual SONY Alpha 7CR in the lower-left corner of the page, like a pasted study reference, with a bold blue hand-drawn arrow pointing toward the main concept sketch, indicating the design inspiration source.

Add authentic notebook details: subtle coffee stains, pencil guidelines, erased construction marks, folded paper corners, light ink smudges, notebook punch holes, slight paper warping, ruler marks, realistic paper grain, marginal engineering notes, and sketchbook wear so it feels like a genuine camera designer’s working notebook.

The main centerpiece should include one tasteful semi-exploded study hinting at internal design intelligence: sensor plane position, shutter mechanism zone, IBIS stabilization area, lens mount depth, heat-management structure, and body-to-grip spatial balance, but rendered selectively and elegantly, not like a full technical blueprint.

items.title: Korean qipao lantern teahouse portrait
items.prompt: Shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera such as the Sony A7R V or Canon EOS R5, using a 50mm prime lens at f/1.8 in cinematic portrait mode with shallow depth of field. The image is captured in high-resolution 8K detail with natural skin texture and realistic micro-details. Warm, dramatic cinematic lighting dominates the scene. Soft golden and deep red ambient light comes from multiple glowing red paper lanterns hanging throughout the traditional wooden interior, creating rich contrast and beautiful rim lighting on the subject’s hair and shoulders. Subtle highlights and gentle shadows sculpt the body and fabric, while a soft fill light gently illuminates the face without flattening the features. The subject is a breathtakingly beautiful Korean woman in her early to mid-20s with flawless, porcelain-smooth skin, delicate facial features, large expressive dark eyes with subtle eyeliner, full natural lips, and long silky black hair cascading over her shoulders. She has an elegant, feminine East Asian bone structure with high cheekbones and a gentle, confident expression. She is seated gracefully on a wooden stool at a rustic wooden table, wearing a form-fitting sleeveless blue silk qipao dress with delicate white floral embroidery and side slits revealing black lace-trimmed stockings. She holds an open blue folding fan with white floral patterns in her right hand near her face, while her left hand rests on the table. Her legs are elegantly crossed and extended toward the camera, wearing glossy black high heels. The shot is taken from a slightly low three-quarter angle, looking slightly up at the subject to emphasize her elegant posture, long legs, and confident presence while keeping the composition balanced and flattering. The atmosphere is intimate, warm, and seductive, set inside a traditional East Asian wooden teahouse or antique room at night. Rich wooden textures, carved panels, and hanging red lanterns create a cozy yet luxurious mood with deep red and golden tones throughout the background. The image evokes a powerful feeling of quiet confidence, sensual elegance, and timeless feminine allure — a breathtaking, almost dreamlike moment of poised beauty and quiet seduction.

items.prompt: 创建一张垂直堆叠的对比图，包含 2 个水平部分：顶部是 1 个小型珐琅冰箱贴的极简主义摄影棚产品照，置于浅蓝色纹理背景中央，留有大量负空间；磁贴呈微型高山风景纪念品形状，带有闪亮的金色金属轮廓、凸起的珐琅细节、积雪的蓝灰色山峰、起伏的绿色丘陵、深色的常青树，以及前景中一簇簇细小的黄色、紫色和蓝色野花，投射出柔和逼真的阴影。底部是 {argument name="location" default="高山草甸山谷"} 在蓝天白云下的明亮逼真风景照：广阔起伏的绿色丘陵、远处带有积雪的山脉、深色的松树林，以及前景中开满黄色、紫色和蓝色花朵的野花草甸。在靠近下方中心的位置，加入 4 名骑马者穿过草甸，在广阔的风景中显得比例较小。使顶部的磁贴呈现出下方风景的精简纪念品版本，并保留相同的关键视觉元素：山脉、绿色丘陵、针叶树、野花和开阔的天空。采用简洁的编辑构图、逼真的光影、清晰的细节、柔和的阴影以及宁静的旅行记忆美学。无可见文字，无标签，无水印。

items.title: 鸟极简封面山雪优雅
items.prompt: 设计一款精致的极简拼贴风格中文文学书籍封面，背景为带有细微颗粒感和淡淡陈旧感的暖白色纹理纸张。构图高挑优雅，右侧居中位置设有一个醒目的竖排中文标题，采用做旧的黑色书法字体，内容为“你当像鸟飞往你的山”，分为两列排版，右列为“你当像鸟”，左列为“飞往你的山”。顶部中央附近有一只精致的靛蓝色飞鸟，一条纤细的蓝色虚线飞行轨迹呈对角线向下延伸，穿过标题并指向右下方，营造出一种升腾与自由的意境。左下方放置一个巨大的三角形山峦形状，如同撕纸拼贴或楔形绘画，山峰呈白色积雪状，向下渐变为深群青色和海军蓝纹理。在山峦右侧边缘融入一条淡淡的竖排英文书籍正文，仿佛山峦是由印刷书页拼凑而成。在蓝色山峦内部，以白色衬线字体排版原始英文标题：第一行“Educated”，下方为“A Memoir”。左上方添加一小块竖排黑色中文引文，排成 6 行，下方加一条长破折号，接着是两行柔和蓝色衬线字体的作者名“Tara Westover”，随后再加一条破折号。右下边缘添加细长的竖排版权信息，包括作者的中文名，后跟蓝色的英文名“Tara Westover”，下方为黑色的译者和出版社信息。保持布局宽敞，利用强烈的留白、不对称平衡感，呈现出诗意的当代出版美学。仅使用 3 种主色：黑色、米白色和靛蓝色。整体氛围应体现出知识分子气息、克制、现代且具有获奖作品的质感，适用于由 {argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"} 创作的 {argument name="book title" default="Educated"} 高端版本。

items.title: 车海报产品优雅
items.prompt: 创建一个 9:16 的竖版奢华营销海报，用于展示一款虚构的跨界产品，即 {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} 与 {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"} 之间极具颠覆性的联名手袋广告。构图采用强烈的对撞拼贴风格，画面中央有一道垂直贯穿的撕纸裂缝，将两种冲突的美学一分为二：左侧为精致的高端奢华品牌风格，采用爱马仕橙、奶油色纸张及优雅的编辑式极简主义；右侧为充满侵略性的中国电商促销风格，以黑色和金属红箔为基调，配以醒目的促销图形、五彩纸屑、撕裂的贴纸以及极具爆发力的折扣字体。在顶部中央，显著放置两个品牌，并配以醒目的中文联名大标题；左侧标志区呈现经典奢侈品牌风格，使用衬线字体和马车徽标，右侧标志区则采用醒目的红色中式品牌风格。下方添加巨大的中文主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}，以及一个带边框的副标题：{argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}。画面中心是一只 Birkin 风格的奢华手袋，正面朝向且尺寸巨大，完美居中但被画面中央的撕裂缝一分为二：左半部分为橙色荔枝纹皮革配金色五金，右半部分为褶皱金属银色皮革配银色五金，两半无缝融合为一只超现实主义手袋。手袋周围或上方应包含 5 个清晰可见的配饰/产品元素：左侧悬挂 1 个橙色钥匙扣，右侧悬挂 1 个带锁的金属银色挂带，1 个中央旋转锁扣及挂锁，左下角放置 1 个带深色丝带的橙色爱马仕风格礼盒，以及左下角附近 1 个带有小徽标的米色防尘袋。手袋左后方是纹理奶油纸上的油画感橙色笔触；手袋右后方是带有火花般高光和飘落纸屑的压碎感红色金属包装纸表面。在右半部分，添加 8 个充满侵略性的促销文字爆点和贴纸，像购物节海报一样呈对角线层叠排列：1 个巨大的白色中文标语“百亿补贴 全网最低”，2 个“限时秒杀!!”，3 个写着“补贴价 ¥999?!”的撕裂价格贴纸，4 个“万件疯抢”，5 个“百亿补贴 官方直补”，6 个“直降到底”，7 个底部重复“补贴价 ¥999?!”的大型撕裂横幅，以及 8 个小字“建议零售价 ¥1000000+”。在左侧边缘，添加一列纤细的垂直编辑式文字，包含 4 个分组文本块，采用奢华布局：1 “限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION”，2 “HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE”，3 “CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE”，4 “DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY”。底部创建一个黑色的 App 风格信息栏，从左至右包含 3 个功能块：1 个带有“拼多多”字样的红色品牌图标，以及一个包含“百亿补贴铂金包”的搜索栏式胶囊按钮，2 个带有闪电图标及“百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价”文字的区域，3 个带有盾牌图标及“正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息”文字的区域。在最底部添加一行细小的中文最终标语。使用超精细的商业产品摄影、高级平面设计、锐利的灯光、压印纹理、箔片反光、纸张撕裂效果和强烈的景深。整体氛围必须如同顶级艺术总监强行将传统奢华广告与混乱的折扣促销海报融合在一起，产生极端的视觉张力、讽刺感和高冲击力的对比。

items.title: 建筑海报像素复古优雅
items.prompt:
目标：为虚构的“电子表格文明系列”创作一张超现实主义复古编辑海报，主题为 {argument name="headline concept" default="BUILDING PYRAMIDS IN EXCEL"}，将古代纪念碑式建筑与过时的办公软件焦虑相结合。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 比例，陈旧的米色纸张背景，带有污渍、灰尘、划痕、模糊的技术绘图标记、细小的套准十字线以及柔和的深褐色调。使用做旧的印刷杂志质感，如同档案科学手册与粗野主义拼贴艺术的结合。

布局：大型排版占据左上象限。一座巨大的阶梯金字塔占据中心和下半部分，采用仰视视角，底部有碎石。右上象限包含一个巨大的扁平橙色时钟图形。小的电子表格、图表和页边笔记像技术注释一样漂浮在金字塔周围。

主体：一座巨大的灰色石制阶梯金字塔，正面垂直裂开。破裂的开口处露出由深色金属板、电缆、管道、服务器、电线和工业机械组成的密集机械内部。混凝土块和碎片向外散落。在金字塔顶部，一个巨大的倾倒的灰白色桶或圆柱形容器正向金字塔右侧倾泻出一大股棕色的沙子或泥土。在桶上放置一个极简的橙色几何标志。

排版与可见文字：左上角的小字写着“// spreadsheet civilization series”以及一个小期刊号“03”。主标题采用高挑优雅的衬线字体堆叠：“BUILDING”然后是“PYRAMIDS”然后是“IN”，下方是超大加粗压缩的橙色块状字母“EXCEL”。在标题下方添加一段小文字：“我们用单元格和行构建我们的纪念碑，像堆砌石头一样堆叠公式，坚信它会永存。”在附近添加“fig. 3 — ambition.exe”。左下角小页脚文字：“v.95”、“build 4.59”、“© 1995–forever”。右下角小页脚文字：“sheet 1 of ∞”、“SUM(ambition)”、“#VALUE!”。在时钟附近，包含橙色的“4:59”以及微小的说明文字“almost done. again.”。在左侧添加一条垂直页边笔记，写着“measure twice, pivot table once.”。

需包含的离散元素：1 座中心破裂的金字塔；1 个倾倒并倾泻沙子的桶；1 个位于右上角的橙色时钟，带有数字 12、3、6、9，黑色指针指向大约 4:59；1 个位于右侧的像素化黑色沙漏图标；1 个位于金字塔下部中心附近的 Microsoft Excel 风格错误对话框；4 个漂浮的电子表格片段。这 4 个电子表格片段分别是：左上角的片段，标有 A、B、C、D 列和十进制数值行；左中部的片段，标有 A、B、C 列和 1–5 行；右中部的片段，标有 F、G 列和标有“Total”及百分比的行；右下角的片段，标有 K、L、M 列以及 Avg、Max、Min 等标签。

错误对话框细节：使对话框看起来像旧版 Windows 95 Microsoft Excel 警告框，带有蓝色标题栏，写着“Microsoft Excel”，一个黄色警告三角形，消息内容为“Not enough memory. Delete rows?”，以及一个居中的“OK”按钮。

视觉风格：模拟拼贴，写实的石头和碎石与扁平的矢量 UI 元素混合，柔和的米色-灰色-黑色调色板，带有焦橙色点缀，高颗粒感，轻微的油墨套印不准，柔和的阴影，磨损的纸张质感，细细的绘图线条以及背景中模糊的圆形图表。

items.title: 建筑3D海报城市
items.prompt: 一张适用于智能手机的竖版天气海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="成都"}，设计风格为梦幻般、超精细的微缩立体模型城市景观，背景为明亮的蓝天。在顶部中心位置，放置醒目的白色粗体中文城市名称，带有柔和的 3D 深度感和轻微的投影效果。在名称正下方，居中放置一个由圆润造型构成的蓬松白色云朵图标。图标下方，添加一行较小的白色文本显示 {argument name="date text" default="2026-04-22 星期三"}，接着是一行较大的白色粗体温度文本 {argument name="temperature text" default="28° / 18°"}，最后再添加一行居中的白色天气状况文本 {argument name="condition text" default="多云"}。保持所有文本垂直堆叠、间距均匀，并整齐地居中于图像上半部分。在下半部分，打造一个融合了中国传统水乡建筑与现代天际线的迷人城市：平静的绿松石色运河环绕着小岛，前景有 2 座小型拱形石桥，左侧岛屿上有一座凉亭，右侧中心附近有一座高大的多层宝塔，错落有致的灰瓦传统民居和店面，摆放着遮阳伞的户外茶桌，茂密的柳树、灌木、花卉以及水面上几艘小船。远景处展示现代化的天际线，包含许多玻璃摩天大楼和 1 座显眼的针状观光塔。在天空中散布恰好 5 朵柔和的积云（包含中央天气图标区域），并添加几只小鸟增添生机。采用温暖的晨光、电影级的空气透视感、浅景深、移轴微缩摄影美学、高度逼真的材质、水面细腻的倒影，以及精致且充满奇趣的旅游海报氛围。保持构图简洁，上方留出充足的天空空间，微缩城市集中在底部，呈现出高端天气应用首屏图像的效果。

items.title: 车写实UI
items.prompt: 创建一张 32:9 的超宽屏照片级逼真赛车游戏截图，视角为 Indy 风格椭圆形赛道比赛中的驾驶员座舱，赛道为 {argument name="race track" default="the Indianapolis 500 speedway"}。摄像机位于黑色开轮式赛车内部的低位，展示了 Halo/驾驶舱边缘、带有微型数字遥测数据的方向盘、部分可见的前轮胎，以及两侧各一个、共 2 个矩形侧后视镜，反射出后方的赛道。前方有 2 辆开轮式竞争对手赛车：左侧为一辆黑蓝色赛车，右侧为一辆黄橙色赛车，均从后方视角呈现，带有巨大的后轮和尾翼，正并排驶入一个平缓的左转倾斜弯道。利用沥青路面、防护网和拥挤看台上的动态模糊营造强烈的速度感，同时保持赛车和驾驶舱主体清晰。赛道为大型椭圆形，配有白色混凝土墙、高大的安全围栏、两侧满座的观众席，远处左中位置设有计分塔/标杆。明亮的午间阳光，蓝天白云，电影级 HDR 真实感，光泽碳纤维，细节丰富的轮胎橡胶，沉浸式 AAA 级赛车模拟器风格。在驾驶舱侧面添加小型白色赞助商风格文字，内容为 {argument name="cockpit sponsor text" default="NEWGARDEN"}，但避免在其他地方出现明显的易读标识。无 UI 覆盖，无水印，无额外车辆，无文字说明。

items.title: 黑白报纸风小说海报
items.prompt: 参考上传图片的黑白暗黑报纸风，把我提供的文章内容重新排版成中文故事海报。黑色磨损纸张背景，白色粗粝字体，旧报纸、杂志拼贴、手写涂抹和划痕质感，不规则分栏排版，重点句使用超大标题或撕纸框突出。文字尽量清晰准确，整体克制、有情绪、有故事感。图片比例 4:5，适合发推；内容放不下可分成多张，每张单独生成，不要拼图，不要水印和多余英文。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:

创作一个完全原创、版权安全的角色，并将其呈现为艺术化的角色身份设定板。

[角色种子]：
在此输入核心想法。

[年龄 / 体型]：
在此输入年龄感、体型、姿态、体态存在感或生物解剖结构。

[视觉媒介]：

[风格]：
在此输入美学方向。

示例：
都市街头时尚、奢华运动时尚大片、暗黑电影黑色风格、柔和忧郁画集氛围、后末日生存装、复古未来时尚、极简高级时装、温馨日常片段、粗粝地下音乐录影带能量、优雅奇幻服装设计、诗意海岸奇幻、生物发光自然史氛围。

[其他细节 - 可选]：
在此输入任何额外细节、限制、情绪、服装提示、道具、颜色、主题、性格提示或呈现偏好。

其余全部自行发明：
角色名、别名或头衔、角色定位、性格特征、情绪基调、视觉主题、服装设计或身体设计、色板、标志性道具或标志性生物特征、可识别剪影、姿态语言、小型身份注记。

原创性规则：
角色不得 resembles 任何现有动漫、漫画、游戏、电影、漫画书、名人、运动员、吉祥物、系列作品角色或已知受版权保护的生物。
不得复制可识别的知识产权元素、服装、发型、制服、武器、标志、符号、配色组合、剪影、能力或标志性视觉特征。
避免同人图美学。
从零创造全新的视觉身份。

角色真实性规则：
创造角色时要有强烈的个体性，避免通用化设计。
避免过度精致、过度理想化或重复的视觉特征，以免角色感觉像默认的 AI 生成脸、库存设计、克隆原型或通用生物。

如果角色是人类或类人：
使用有辨识度的面部结构、微妙的非对称、自然变化、小瑕疵和可信比例。
角色应当感觉具体、落地且可识别为独立个体。
如果角色有吸引力，保持自然、得体，并适合所选视觉媒介。

如果角色是风格化角色：
通过原创形状语言、富有表现力的比例、鲜明特征、姿态和清晰性格线索来保留独特性。
避免默认类型俗套和重复审美标准。

如果角色是非人类：
通过原创解剖结构、可信的生物结构、独特比例、功能性特征、表面质感和清晰性格线索来保留独特性。
不要让它感觉像通用吉祥物、宠物怪物或模板化奇幻生物。

媒介与风格控制：
[视觉媒介] 控制渲染语言。
[风格] 控制美学方向。
角色身份设定板格式只是呈现格式。
呈现方式必须适配 [视觉媒介] 和 [风格]，而不是覆盖它们。
使用自然属于所选媒介的视觉特征。

创作一个艺术化 16:9 角色身份设定板。

设定板应感觉像精心策划的视觉身份呈现，而不是通用转面设定表。

设定板内容：
大幅全身主角色视图、中性全身视图、背面视图、侧面视图、次要态度姿势、4 到 6 个面部或表情研究、服装细节特写或解剖细节特写、关键道具特写或标志性特征特写、小型剪影或形状研究、色板条、简短可读的身份注释。

布局：

设定板上的文字可以包括：
角色名、别名、角色定位、性格特征、核心主题、标志性道具或特征、色彩说明。

背景：
纯白或柔和米白，极简干净平面设计，无环境，无标志，无水印。

优先考虑：
准确的视觉媒介、强烈独特的身份感、清晰可读的服装设计或解剖设计、清晰性格、原创角色设计、根据情况自然或风格化的个体性、可信的独特性、不重复的角色设计、艺术化身份设定板呈现。

items.title: 3D女性
items.promptZh:
为“ATHELETE_NAME”设计一张4:5的体育艺术海报，采用写实、柔和、厚重的绘画式运动场域，将球员的跃起转译为具有方向性的笔触能量，采用垂直升腾的构图，情感目标是自律的超越与冷峻的精准。

概念：球员不仅被描绘出来——他本身就是由力量构建而成的。他标志性的跳跃以基于PLAYER球队球衣色彩的写实笔触涌动来呈现，像一次受控的爆炸般升起，把运动中的腾空转化为一种关于向上压力、纪律与动势的视觉语言。海报捕捉的是身体力量化为抽象运动的那一瞬间。

主体：球员被表现为一个占据主导的半抽象人物，从层层叠叠、柔和、仿佛刚刚绘就的笔触中浮现，而非一张完全写实的照片。他的身体被部分界定——面部结构与躯干清晰可辨——但四肢消融为挥洒的厚重绘画笔势，尤其是腿部和手臂周围，以强调升腾与运动。人物向上倾斜，仿佛仍在攀爬，占据中央垂直轴线，却从不被完全框住。

构图：垂直升腾式布局，底部三分之一密集堆叠着厚重、柔和、写实的笔触，向上逐渐展开为更轻盈、更流动的留白。视线路径从厚重、落地的绘画肌理出发，向上穿过流动的线条与碎片化的形体，抵达球员悬于空中的存在。顶部的负空间充当一片平静的高光区域，与下方密集的绘画能量形成对比。背景如同一片刚刚绘就的氛围，而非平坦的色块，方向性笔触强化了向上的运动。

字体排版：主标题：“RISE WITHOUT LIMIT”，采用窄体运动风无衬线刷绘字体，在左侧垂直拉伸，并被柔和的笔触部分遮盖，仿佛从层层颜料中浮现。其基线微妙地向上弯曲，顺应笔触的运动。
副标题：“Discipline becomes flight.”，采用克制的 grotesk 字体，置于画面下方颜料最密集处，为概念提供锚点。点缀性微文字以细如手写标注的形式融入笔触之中，呼应运动轨迹，而非作为静态文字存在。

光照：采用绘画性的光照逻辑而非摄影写实——高对比高光使用最浅的球衣颜色或白色绘制的笔触来模拟方向光，而较深的球衣色调则营造阴影深度。人物被界定的区域接受微妙、受控的高光，以在抽象之中保持可读性。

色彩：主色调基于PLAYER当前或最具标志性的球队球衣颜色。以主球衣色作为锚色，以次球衣色作为主要的动势点缀色，以白色或最浅的球衣色调用于高光与负空间对比。阴影应偏向可用的最深球衣颜色或主队色的加深版本。辅助色调可包括仅由球衣色板衍生出的柔化、去饱和过渡色。整体色板必须让人感觉是为球员的球队身份量身定制，同时保持清晰、克制与强烈。

风格：抽象表现主义体育艺术与有纪律的运动品牌美学相融合；写实的绘画式动势与精准的表现相遇。该风格如同一幅达到画廊水准的体育肖像，在柔和、厚重的笔触能量与受控的构图之间取得平衡。

完成度：可见的写实笔触肌理，具有层叠的颜料深度，密集区域呈现柔和厚重的厚涂效果，上部区域则是更平滑、仿佛刚刚稀释过的笔触。没有数字光泽——完成效果偏向触感与艺术性，颜料消融进负空间处带有柔和的边缘羽化。没有多余的叠加层或人工特效。

页脚：一个极简、一体化的页脚，镌刻于下方颜料块体之中，使用小号大写无衬线字体
items.prompt:
Design a 4:5 sports art poster for 'ATHELETE_NAME' using realistic, soft, thick painted motion fields, player’s leap translated into directional brush energy, a vertical ascension composition, and an emotional goal of disciplined transcendence and cold precision. 

CONCEPT: player is not just depicted—he is constructed out of force. His iconic jump is visualized as a surge of realistic paint strokes based on PLAYER’s team jersey colors, rising like a controlled explosion, turning athletic elevation into a visual language of upward pressure, discipline, and momentum. The poster captures the instant where physical power becomes abstract motion. 

SUBJECT: player rendered as a dominant semi-abstract figure emerging from layered, soft, freshly painted strokes rather than a fully literal photograph. His body is partially defined—recognizable facial structure and torso clarity—but limbs dissolve into sweeping, thick paint gestures, especially around the legs and arms, emphasizing lift and motion. The figure is angled upward, as if still climbing, occupying the central vertical axis but never fully contained. 

COMPOSITION: A vertical ascension layout where the bottom third is dense with heavy, soft, realistic brush strokes, gradually opening into lighter, more fluid white space toward the top. The eye path starts at thick, grounded painted textures and travels upward through flowing lines and fragmented form into player’s mid-air presence. Negative space at the top acts as a zone of calm highlight contrast against the dense painted energy below. The background behaves like a freshly painted atmosphere, not a flat field, with directional strokes reinforcing upward motion.

TYPOGRAPHY: Headline: 'RISE WITHOUT LIMIT' set in a condensed athletic sans-serif brushed text, vertically stretched on the left side, and partially masked by soft paint strokes, as if emerging through layers. The baseline subtly curves upward, following the motion of the brushwork. 
Subhead: 'Discipline becomes flight.' in a restrained grotesk, placed lower in the composition where the paint is densest, anchoring the concept. Accent microtext appears as thin, almost hand-marked annotations integrated into the brushwork, echoing motion paths rather than sitting as static text. 

LIGHTING: Painterly lighting logic rather than photographic realism—high-contrast highlights use the lightest jersey color or white painted strokes to simulate directional light, while darker jersey tones create shadow depth. The figure’s defined areas receive subtle, controlled highlights to maintain legibility within abstraction. 

COLORS: Dominant palette based on PLAYER’s current or most iconic team jersey colors. Use the primary jersey color as the anchor, the secondary jersey color as the main motion accent, and white or the lightest jersey tone for highlights and negative-space contrast. Shadows should lean into the darkest available jersey color or a deepened version of the primary team color. Supporting tones may include softened, desaturated transitions derived from the jersey palette only. The overall palette must feel customized to the player’s team identity while preserving clarity, control, and intensity. 

STYLE: Abstract expressionist sports art fused with disciplined athletic branding; realistic painterly motion meets precision performance. The style feels like a gallery-worthy sports portrait, balancing soft, thick brush energy with controlled composition. 

FINISH: Visible realistic brush textures with layered paint depth, soft thick impasto effect in dense areas, and smoother, freshly diluted strokes in upper regions. No digital gloss—finish leans tactile and artistic, with gentle edge feathering where paint dissolves into negative space. No unnecessary overlays or artificial effects. 

FOOTER: A minimal, integrated footer carved into the lower paint mass, using small uppercase sans-serif text

items.title: 九宫格可爱贴纸页
items.prompt:
一张可爱、治愈风格的手绘贴纸页，背景为纯白色。整体构图为整洁的 3x3 网格，共 9 个独立贴纸单元，以均匀间距排列，不显示可见网格线，并保留充足的留白空间。

每个单元格中都包含一个风格统一的极简祖国人卡通角色：极简的抽象一下主要特征。角色的表情极简；
每个单元格中的角色都呈现不同的动作或姿态，并搭配一句简短的手写中文短语（例如：打卡、摸鱼、开会、加班、好困、无语、好饿、吃啥、没钱、迟到、下班、加油、画饼、拒绝、开摆），通过对话气泡、小牌子或手势互动来表现内容。

配色方面：每个单元格使用一种主导色，颜色从 红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、紫 中选择，色调柔和但饱和度较高，且仅应用于文字、对话框或少量小装饰元素。黑色线稿保持不变。不要使用渐变，全部为纯色平涂。

角色和文字位于每个单元格的中央或略微偏中心的位置，整体保留充足的呼吸感和留白。阴影要么完全没有，要么极其轻微。文字风格类似于小孩子随手写的字，俏皮可爱但仍然清晰易读。线条略微圆润。

整体风格：可爱（kawaii）、治愈、极简、手绘、Q版、扁平插画、贴纸包、表情包合集。

负面提示词（Negative Prompt）：
写实、3D、复杂背景、渐变、厚重阴影、可见网格边框、标准印刷字体、细致五官、凌乱排版、文字错误。

items.promptZh:
创作一张照片级写实的2×2角色时尚杂志拼贴，整体约为3:4竖幅。每个分格都必须呈现同一位明确成年的女性，视觉年龄约22至28岁，面部结构、妆容、发色、女仆装和头饰保持一致。不要将四张图合并成一个连续场景。

她有一张紧凑的椭圆脸、窄下颌和非常玩偶化的眼部比例。她的妆容融合日式哥特洛丽塔肖像、玩偶感时尚大片和韩式社交媒体美妆造型：苍白半哑光底妆、细自然眉、灰绿色或冷灰色放大美瞳、拉长黑色眼线、上下睫毛分明、眼下柔和粉色晕染、几颗细小雀斑状或美人痣状点缀、鼻尖柔和高光，以及低饱和灰粉色裸唇。她的双唇微张，不露笑容。左上近景中，她睁大眼睛直视镜头；其他分格中，她的眼睑更放松，或视线略微偏向一侧。整体表情应安静、疏离、从容自持，像一件发展出自我意志的华丽玩偶。

她的头发是深栗棕色，在直闪下反射出温暖巧克力棕的缎面光泽。头发长至胸部或腰部，搭配整齐、轻柔蓬松的齐刘海。保留两缕弯曲的修饰脸型发束，发尾略向内弯，并有自然松散的弧线。加入少量飞散碎发、躺姿分格中头发的自然铺散，以及不同照片之间刘海位置的小变化。避免僵硬的假发质感或完全一致的造型。

她穿着复古日式风格女仆裙，颜色为深藏青与奶油白。上身有方形领口、白色围裙面板、深藏青短泡泡袖、白色镂空花边袖口和深色缎面蝴蝶结细节。裙摆短而外扩，带有层叠白色褶边围裙和蕾丝衬裙。蕾丝应显得轻盈、纤薄、略带半透明，并可见细腻纹理。藏青面料更厚实，能保持有结构的钟形轮廓。搭配烟黑色透肤过膝长袜和亮面黑色厚底玛丽珍高跟鞋。她宽大的黑白女仆头饰由立体奶油色褶边、深色缎带和两侧大黑蝴蝶结构成。

可见皮肤包括整张脸、颈部、少量锁骨、上臂、前臂、双手，以及裙摆与长袜之间的小面积大腿皮肤。她的肤色为浅中性象牙色，带细微冷粉底色。硬闪光让皮肤显得奶油般明亮，阴影区域则偏向柔和灰米色。表面看起来经过精心化妆，但视觉上仍暗示柔软、细腻、微凉且略带粉感的触感。保留自然关节色差、细微毛孔，以及手指、膝盖和手臂周围的小褶皱。避免塑料或硅胶感皮肤。

左上分格是接近视线高度拍摄的半身近景肖像。她直视相机，并用一根手指轻轻触碰一只眼睛下方或脸颊。部分黑色手枪形戏剧道具从画面侧边进入。构图紧凑，女仆头饰和头发占据上部，方形领口与围裙面板在下方可见。

右上分格是坐在华丽古典扶手椅中的全身姿势。她的双腿在座椅和前景中弯曲交叠，清楚展示透肤黑色长袜和厚底高跟鞋。双臂举过头顶，每只手各持一把黑色手枪形角色道具。手臂形成不完美的三角形框架。藏青裙摆与白色蕾丝向外铺开，露出丰富层叠的褶边。

左下分格从正上方俯拍。她躺在棕色地板上，头部靠近分格下边缘。长发像扇子一样自然铺散。不要旋转或校正这一构图。双手在胸前持有一把黑色手枪形道具。藏青裙摆和白色蕾丝在身体上方聚拢，同时一条弯曲的腿进入画面。保留轻微失衡感和即兴快照感。

右下分格采用四分之三侧视角。她向前俯身伏在一架深色立式钢琴上。一只手撑在琴键或琴身附近，另一只手将黑色道具垂向地面。她转头回望相机。长发垂落在脸旁并沿背部落下。藏青裙摆在她身后形成钟形轮廓，白色蕾丝裙边仍清晰可见。

所有手枪形物体都必须表现为无功能的戏剧或Cosplay道具，仅用于时尚与悬疑叙事。不要展示真实型号标识、内部机械结构、射击程序、枪口火光、弹壳、血迹或伤口。不要将道具指向观者。

场景是一间昏暗而繁复的复古音乐室、维多利亚风格客厅或哥特式私人沙龙。包括一架可见琴键的深色立式钢琴、一把带浅灰花纹软包的雕花木扶手椅、一盏带流苏或珠饰边的复古灯、层叠的灰棕与青铜色缎面帷幔、一张圆形雕花边桌、玻璃杯、小瓶子、金色托盘，以及装裱的复古蝴蝶标本展示。房间应像一间时间凝固的古董娃娃屋：精致、封闭、安静，并隐约诡异。

像21世纪初便携数码相机或早期社交媒体角色大片那样拍摄这张拼贴。使用靠近镜头光轴的硬直闪光。脸部、白色围裙和蕾丝变得明亮，鼻梁、眼下、手背、手臂和大腿出现集中高光。刘海、下巴、蕾丝饰边和裙层下方形成短而边缘清晰的阴影。光线迅速衰减，将钢琴、窗帘、深色木家具和房间角落压入深棕或黑色欠曝中。只保留微弱暖钨丝灯光和青铜金色环境反射。不要添加蓝色轮廓光、大型柔光箱或均匀平衡的商业补光。

保留轻微高光泛光、暗部噪点、JPEG压缩、局部锐度不均、曝光变化，以及分格之间白平衡的小差异。姿势、堆叠裙层、飞散碎发和裁切不必完美精致。她已经换上女仆装，进入昏暗的旧音乐室。她现在触碰脸颊、举起双手、躺在相机下方，最后俯身靠向钢琴。下一个分格感觉仿佛可能揭示甜美造型之下隐藏的故事。融合日式哥特女仆时尚、暗黑洛丽塔、玩偶感妆容、维多利亚室内与早期数码直闪摄影。

负面：未成年外观、单张图像、错误拼贴、对镜自拍、手机遮挡脸、多余人物、各分格面部不一致、发色变化、服装变化、多余手臂、多余手指、畸形手、关节错位、肢体穿插、道具穿插、道具指向相机、射击动作、枪口火光、弹壳、血迹、伤口、露骨裸体、服装走光、夸张胸部、极细腰、塑料皮肤、蜡感脸、现代白色影棚、均匀柔光、蓝色轮廓光、重度HDR、过度锐化、无噪点商业大片、动漫、明显3D渲染。
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 2×2 character-editorial collage in an approximately 3:4 vertical format. Every panel must feature the same clearly adult woman, visually around 22 to 28 years old, with consistent facial structure, makeup, hair color, maid costume and headwear. Do not merge the four images into one continuous scene.

She has a compact oval face, a narrow jaw and prominently doll-like eye proportions. Her makeup combines Japanese gothic-lolita portraiture, doll-inspired editorials and Korean social-media beauty styling: a pale semi-matte base, fine natural brows, gray-green or cool-gray enlarging contacts, elongated black eyeliner, clearly separated upper and lower lashes, soft pink shading beneath the eyes, a few tiny freckle-like or beauty-mark dots, a gentle nose-tip highlight and muted gray-pink nude lips. Her lips remain slightly parted without a smile. In the upper-left close-up, she opens her eyes wide and looks directly into the lens. In the other panels, her eyelids are more relaxed or her gaze shifts slightly sideways. The overall expression should feel quiet, detached and self-possessed, like an ornate doll that has developed a will of its own.

Her hair is deep chestnut brown, reflecting warm chocolate-brown satin highlights under direct flash. It is long enough to reach the chest or waist and paired with a neat, softly airy blunt fringe. Preserve two curved face-framing sections, slightly inward-bending ends and loose natural arcs. Include a few flyaway hairs, the natural spread of hair in the reclining panel and small variations in fringe placement between photographs. Avoid a rigid wig texture or perfectly uniform styling.

She wears a vintage Japanese-inspired maid dress in deep navy and creamy white. The bodice has a square neckline, a white apron panel, short navy puff sleeves, white eyelet-lace cuffs and dark satin bow details. The skirt is short and flared, with a layered white ruffled apron and lace petticoat. The lace appears light, thin and mildly translucent, with fine visible texture. The navy fabric is thicker and holds a structured bell-shaped silhouette. Add smoky-black sheer thigh-high stockings and glossy black platform Mary Jane heels. Her wide black-and-white maid headband is built from sculptural creamy ruffles, dark satin ribbons and large black bows on both sides.

Visible skin includes the full face, neck, a small amount of collarbone, upper arms, forearms, hands and small areas of upper-thigh skin between the skirt and stockings. Her complexion is light neutral ivory with a subtle cool-pink undertone. Hard flash makes the skin appear creamy and bright, while shadowed areas shift toward soft gray-beige. The surface looks carefully made-up but still visually suggests a soft, fine, slightly cool and faintly powdery touch. Preserve natural joint color variation, subtle pores and small creases around the fingers, knees and arms. Avoid plastic or silicone-like skin.

The upper-left panel is a close bust portrait photographed near eye level. She looks directly into the camera and lightly touches the area beneath one eye or the cheek with a finger. Part of a black handgun-shaped theatrical prop enters from the side of the frame. The composition is tight, with the maid headpiece and hair filling the upper section and the square neckline and apron panel visible below.

The upper-right panel is a full-body pose seated in an ornate classical armchair. Her legs bend and overlap across the seat and foreground, clearly showing the sheer black stockings and platform heels. Both arms rise above her head, with a black handgun-shaped character prop in each hand. The arms form an imperfect triangular frame. The navy skirt and white lace spread outward, revealing rich layers of ruffles.

The lower-left panel is photographed directly from above. She lies on a brown floor with her head near the bottom edge of the panel. Her long hair spreads naturally like a fan. Do not rotate or correct this composition. Both hands hold a black handgun-shaped prop near the chest. The navy skirt and white lace gather above the body, while one bent leg enters the frame. Preserve a slight imbalance and spontaneous snapshot feeling.

The lower-right panel uses a three-quarter side view. She leans forward over a dark upright piano. One hand braces near the piano keys or casing, while the other lowers a black prop toward the floor. Her head turns back toward the camera. Long hair falls beside the face and along the back. The navy skirt forms a bell-shaped silhouette behind her, with the white lace hem remaining clearly visible.

All handgun-shaped objects must read as non-functional theatrical or cosplay props used only for fashion and suspense storytelling. Do not show real model markings, internal mechanics, firing procedures, muzzle flashes, shell casings, blood or injury. Do not point the props toward the viewer.

The setting is a dim and elaborate vintage music room, Victorian-inspired parlor or gothic private salon. Include a dark upright piano with visible keys, a carved wooden armchair with pale gray patterned upholstery, a vintage lamp with fringe or beaded trim, layered gray-brown and bronze satin drapes, a round carved side table, glasses, small bottles, a gold tray and a framed vintage butterfly-specimen display. The room should resemble a time-frozen antique dollhouse: refined, enclosed, quiet and faintly uncanny.

Photograph the collage like an early-2000s compact digital camera or early social-media character editorial. Use hard direct flash close to the lens axis. The face, white apron and lace become bright, while concentrated highlights appear across the nose bridge, under-eye area, backs of the hands, arms and thighs. Short, clearly edged shadows form beneath the fringe, chin, lace trim and skirt layers. The light falls off rapidly, pushing the piano, curtains, dark wood furniture and corners of the room into deep brown or black underexposure. Retain only weak warm tungsten light and bronze-gold environmental reflections. Do not add blue rim lighting, large softboxes or evenly balanced commercial fill.

Preserve slight highlight bloom, dark-area noise, JPEG compression, uneven local sharpness, exposure variation and small white-balance differences between panels. The poses, stacked skirt layers, flyaway hairs and cropping do not need to be perfectly polished. She had already changed into the maid costume and entered the dim old music room. She now touches her cheek, raises both hands, lies beneath the camera and finally leans toward the piano. The next panel feels as though it might reveal the story hidden beneath the sweet styling. Blend Japanese gothic maid fashion, dark lolita, doll-like makeup, Victorian interiors and early digital direct-flash photography.

背景：纯哑光白画布。在主体后方放置一个大型圆角矩形色块，约占据海报高度的 70%、宽度的 76%，居中并略高于中线。该色块使用受控的 [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] 渐变，自左上向右下柔和发光。在主体与产品后方，放置巨型裁切排版文字“[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]”，采用超粗几何无衬线字体。该词仅作为背景图层：尺寸巨大、部分被画框边缘裁切、宽字距、比矩形更深的 [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]、微妙的浮雕立体感、柔和阴影，且对比度足够低，不与产品争夺视觉焦点。

主体与产品：[DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — 例如“一位拥有干净时尚编辑感造型的女性模特，表情中性自信，发丝自然微带风的动感，身着低饱和米白色服装，外搭 [ACCENT COLOR] 夹克”]。以略低的主视觉角度拍摄。身体倾斜以营造纵深，面部转向观者并直接眼神接触。一只手伸向镜头，握着上传参考图中的产品。产品是占据主导地位的前景物体，略微倾斜以展现 [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — 例如“三摄系统、拉丝钛金属边缘与居中的品牌标识”]。保持产品锐利清晰，具备真实的表面反射、材质纹理、细微微观细节，并在高端特征周围带有柔和光晕。保持模特面部在产品后方依然清晰可辨。

光照：来自左前方的柔和影棚主光，来自右侧的暖色轮廓光，以及来自背景色块的微妙 [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] 反弹光。皮肤保持自然、不做过度磨皮，拥有真实的眼神光。产品边缘具有干净的 [MATERIAL FINISH — 例如“金属 / 哑光 / 高光”] 高光。阴影柔和且受控。

排版文字叠加层：所有文字必须为扁平、清晰、完美对齐的图形排版——而非绘制在场景之中。以下文字元素各仅渲染一次，不得出现额外文字：

左上角，小号黑色标志：[BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

右上角，细体无衬线：“[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — 例如‘Built for Apple Intelligence。’]”

中部左侧，玻璃拟态胶囊标签：“[PRODUCT NAME — 例如‘iPhone 17 Pro’]”

大型背景字体：“[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]”

右下角正文文案，小号干净无衬线：
“[PRODUCT NAME]。[POWER STATEMENT — 一句话。]
[FEATURE 1]。[FEATURE 2]。
[CLOSING LINE — 例如‘Designed for what's next。’]”

底部功能条：沿底部放置四张等宽玻璃白色圆角卡片，与网格对齐，高度相同、间距相同、基线对齐。每张卡片在标题上方有一个极简线性图标。严格渲染：
卡片 1：“[FEATURE HEADING 1]” / “[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]”
卡片 2：“[FEATURE HEADING 2]” / “[FEATURE SUBLINE 2]”
卡片 3：“[FEATURE HEADING 3]” / “[FEATURE SUBLINE 3]”
卡片 4：“[FEATURE HEADING 4]” / “[FEATURE SUBLINE 4]”

图形细节：仅两到三个小型星芒图标，微妙的颗粒质感，柔和玻璃拟态，受控的 [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]-白-[ACCENT COLOR] 配色，无霓虹感，无过度饱和。
items.prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE INSTRUCTION: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact source of truth for the product's appearance, color, finish, branding, and form factor. Do not invent or alter any product detail. Reproduce it with photorealistic precision.
---
Create a photorealistic premium [PRODUCT CATEGORY] campaign poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Design it as a clean global OOH, digital, and social campaign layout with strict grid alignment, premium white space, and precise typography. The campaign idea is "[CAMPAIGN TAGLINE]," but do not render that phrase as visible text.

Use a strict 12-column poster grid with 6% outer margins. Keep all text aligned to this grid. The image has four layers: background shape, giant background typography, subject/product photography, and clean graphic text overlays.

BACKGROUND: Pure matte white canvas. Place one large rounded-rectangle block behind the subject, occupying roughly 70% of the poster height and 76% of the width, centered slightly above the middle. The block uses a controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] gradient, glowing gently from top-left to bottom-right. Behind the subject and product, place giant cropped typography reading "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]" in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif letters. The word is a background layer only: huge, partially cropped by the frame edges, wide letter spacing, darker [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] than the rectangle, subtle embossed depth, soft shadow, and low enough contrast that it does not fight the product.

SUBJECT AND PRODUCT: [DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — e.g., "a female model with a clean editorial look, neutral confident expression, natural slightly wind-touched hair, muted off-white outfit, and [ACCENT COLOR] jacket"]. Shoot from a slightly low hero angle. Body angled for depth, face turned toward the viewer with direct eye contact. One hand extends toward the camera holding the product from the uploaded reference image. The product is the dominant foreground object, slightly tilted to reveal [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — e.g., "the triple camera system, brushed titanium edges, and centered brand logo"]. Keep the product sharp with realistic surface reflections, material texture, faint micro-details, and soft bloom around premium features. Keep the model's face readable behind it.

LIGHTING: Soft studio key light from front-left, warm rim light from the right, and subtle [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] bounce from the background block. Skin remains natural and non-airbrushed with realistic catchlights. Product edges have clean [MATERIAL FINISH — e.g., "metallic / matte / glossy"] highlights. Shadows are soft and controlled.

TYPOGRAPHY OVERLAY: All text must be flat, crisp, perfectly aligned graphic typography — not painted onto the scene. Render exactly these text elements once, with no extra text:

Top left, small black logo: [BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

Top right, thin sans-serif: "[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — e.g., 'Built for Apple Intelligence.']"

Mid left, glassmorphism pill: "[PRODUCT NAME — e.g., 'iPhone 17 Pro']"

Large background type: "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]"

Bottom right body copy, small clean sans-serif:
"[PRODUCT NAME]. [POWER STATEMENT — one sentence.]
[FEATURE 1]. [FEATURE 2].
[CLOSING LINE — e.g., 'Designed for what's next.']"

BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP: Place four equal-width glass-white rounded cards along the bottom, aligned to the grid, same height, same spacing, same baseline alignment. Each card has one minimal line icon above the heading. Render exactly:
Card 1: "[FEATURE HEADING 1]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]"
Card 2: "[FEATURE HEADING 2]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 2]"
Card 3: "[FEATURE HEADING 3]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 3]"
Card 4: "[FEATURE HEADING 4]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 4]"

GRAPHIC DETAILS: Two or three small sparkle icons only, subtle grain, soft glassmorphism, controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]-white-[ACCENT COLOR] palette, no neon, no oversaturation.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh: 《Jujutsu Kaisen》中的 Nobara Kugusaki，以 Kubo tite 风格的厚漆插图呈现。侧面、半身特写，人物忠实地符合原设计，目光指向左侧。极简主义的米色背景，具有广泛的负空间，构图向右倾斜。干净、优质的美感，柔和的电影灯光、边缘光、高对比度但低饱和度的调色板，微妙的强调色反映了角色的主色调。几何多面绘画风格，具有细致的皮肤纹理和发丝。商业海报布局采用大胆的标题排版设计。垂直 9:16 格式。

items.prompt: POV视角，从客机舷窗向外望去，黑袍纠察队的祖国人正与飞机并肩飞行，与镜头直接对视，面带微笑但压迫感十足。画面由手机拍摄，带有轻微抖动、曝光不均和真实的玻璃反光，增强临场感与纪录片氛围。远处是广阔的云海与蓝天，光线强烈而真实。

items.title: White cat cosplay bedroom portrait
items.prompt:
A photorealistic natural portrait of a fictional 20-year-old adult Japanese woman, clearly adult, with a cute Japanese idol-like face, wearing a soft white cat-inspired cosplay outfit. She has a small soft oval face, large warm brown eyes looking directly at the camera, a small straight nose, glossy natural pink lips, a bright friendly smile, gentle cheek blush, natural facial asymmetry, realistic pores, and slight skin imperfections.

She has light brown medium-length hair with soft straight bangs, long side locks framing her cheeks, and the back loosely tied in a relaxed half-up style. She wears fluffy white cat ears with pale pink inner details, a small ribbon accent, a simple light choker with a tiny bell, and oversized fluffy white paw gloves with soft pink paw pads.

She is kneeling on a fluffy white rug in a bright pastel bedroom, leaning slightly forward in a cute playful pose. One paw glove is raised near her cheek, showing the pink paw pad toward the camera, while the other paw rests naturally on the rug. Her shoulders are relaxed, her face is slightly tilted upward, and she smiles warmly in a natural candid way. The camera angle is slightly high and close, like a clean lifestyle portrait.

She wears a soft white camisole layered under a fluffy white cardigan, with simple high-waisted white shorts. The outfit is cute, clean, cozy, and not revealing. The fabric fits naturally to her body with gentle wrinkles and soft texture, keeping a wholesome adult fashion cosplay mood. Bright diffused daylight, soft pastel background, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, high-resolution DSLR photo, natural color grading, not overly retouched.

items.title: 极简宇宙室内
items.prompt:
你是一位专业的室内设计 Mood Board 创作者。基于提供的 {argument name="space type" default="bedroom"} 设计照片，生成一张高端的 3:4 竖版 Mood Board。整体视觉效果应参考专业设计提案，展示 {argument name="style name" default="Modern Mid-century"} 的美学特征，营造 [Mood Keywords] 的氛围，并符合 [Branding Tone] 的设计表达。
空间类型：{argument name="space type" default="bedroom"}
布局要求：
上部：一张高分辨率、照片级的 {argument name="space type" default="bedroom"} 室内渲染图。它必须在结构、家具、材料、色彩和灯光上与用户的照片保持一致，但需针对专业提案进行优化。重点关注：[Key Furniture Elements]、[Material Keywords]、[Color Palette]、[Lighting Style]。
下部：展示严格对应上方设计的材料和家具样本，包括：材料样本、织物样本、色卡、饰面样本，以及相关的木材/石材/金属/玻璃/皮革样本。所有内容必须反映方案的核心材料和色彩逻辑。
右下角：一个设计说明 / 配色方案信息框，显示：主色、辅色、点缀色、核心材料、饰面描述和风格关键词。
风格与输出：
专业公司级布局；极简、干净、克制且有序；清晰的视觉层级和留白控制；材料/颜色标签清晰且现代；整体氛围与 {argument name="style name" default="Modern Mid-century"} 相符；渲染质量：4K 超高清，超精细，照片级渲染。3:4 竖版构图。
标签要求：
每个样本必须有一个清晰的标签，按 [Label Language] 的材料/颜色/饰面名称组织，风格简洁、专业且对齐整齐。

items.title: 食物信息图写实
items.prompt:
以“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面必须呈现“单个完整的食物主体”（例如：一个土豆 / 一串香蕉 / 一个大蒜），通过横向切片展示同一食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而非多个不同个体的拼贴。

食物主体保持结构连续性和形状一致，在不同切片区域呈现出不同成熟度（如同将时间切开）。

图片采用 3:4 竖屏比例，主体居中并横向延展，均匀分为 4-6 个片段：

从左至右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每个片段反映真实变化：

颜色变化（如：绿 → 黄 → 黑等）
质地变化（如：饱满 → 变软 → 萎缩 → 腐烂）
特征变化（如：发芽、出水、发霉等）

每个阶段配有文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特征
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高度写实的摄影风格
清晰的分隔线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用 等图标

顶部标题：“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”

核心要求：必须呈现为“同一食物随时间变化的切片”，而非独立个体的拼贴。

The lower outfit consists of loose white cargo pants layered with exaggerated light blue and dark blue stacked denim leg warmers, paired with beige sneakers and a black crossbody shoulder bag.
The composition uses an extreme low-angle perspective shot, making the legs and shoes appear dramatically enlarged for intense visual impact, as if the character is jumping directly over the viewer’s head. The pose feels anti-gravity and surreal — one arm stretched outward while one leg kicks forward dynamically, creating a floating airborne motion.
The background features a bright cyan-blue sky with soft white clouds, illuminated by clean sunlight and strong atmospheric depth. The overall visual style blends luxury fashion editorial photography, surreal streetwear advertising, and experimental urban poster design.
Add two smaller collage-style silhouette versions of the character in the top-right and bottom-left corners — one floating in the air and another mid-jump — creating the feeling of a fashion magazine collage layout.
Poster layout should resemble a square luxury magazine cover adapted to a 9:16 vertical composition. Add massive abstract rounded typography at the top inspired by Y2K bubble fonts and experimental streetwear brand logos. Include a small graffiti-style brand mark on the left side. On the right side, place a white handwritten brush-style slogan reading: “RISE ABOVE WITH FASHION”, followed by tiny editorial-style caption text underneath. Add a small barcode centered at the bottom.
The design should include thin white borders and a soft off-white paper texture overlay.
Style keywords: futuristic street fashion, avant-garde clothing design, Y2K graphic design, magazine cover typography, collage silhouettes, extreme low-angle shot, sky background, surreal floating motion, exaggerated perspective, premium streetwear campaign, realistic fabric texture, ultra-detailed, clean luxury aesthetic.
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical.

该作品采用了撕纸拼贴美学，具有分层纹理、撕裂边缘、胶带碎片和阴影重叠。将逼真的摄影风格与艺术颗粒和墨水飞溅效果相结合。

以混合字体添加强排版：

items.title: 极简字体冷调优雅
items.prompt: 一张 16:9 比例的极简主义编辑风格演示 Slides，采用暖浅灰色纸张背景，留白充裕，布局遵循精致的瑞士风格网格，具备高端 PPT/Keynote 设计美感。该 Slides 为关于“锁定”的对比页面，使用优雅的中文排版并混合微小的英文导航文本。左上角放置两行小型大写英文面包屑导航：“COMPARISON · LOCK-IN”及下方的“CLOSED VS OPEN”，使用字间距较宽的细体无衬线字体。右上角放置页码指示器“04 / 08”。在上半部分居中偏左处，添加一行超大号加粗黑色中文字体标题：“真正的锁定，不是模型，是记忆。”在标题下方的左侧区域，创建三行对比列表，行间以细横线分隔。第一行左侧为加粗中文标签“轻度风险”，右侧为解释说明“状态存在服务端，换模型后无法恢复线程。”，最右侧对齐一个微小的大写英文关键词：“STATE”。第二行左侧为加粗标签“中度风险”，右侧为说明“闭源 harness 的记忆形态不可见，难以迁移。”，最右侧关键词为“SHAPE”。第三行左侧为加粗标签“最高风险”，右侧为说明“整个 harness 和长期记忆都在 API 后面。”，最右侧关键词为“LOCK-IN”。在 Slides 右侧放置一张小型嵌入式对比图表卡片，背景为白色，带有细微边框，包含两个并排的系统架构面板。左侧面板代表封闭系统，采用深灰色和柔和的红色点缀；右侧面板代表开放系统，采用深蓝色点缀。每个面板顶部应有 5 个小型图标标签，中央有一个高亮的 harness 模块，下方堆叠多个圆角矩形模块，底部一行有 4 个带有简短中文标签的小型能力图标。保持嵌入图细节丰富但尺寸较小，使其作为辅助视觉元素而非视觉重心。左下角添加微小的浅灰色中文页脚文本：“布局测试 · 顶部标题 + 下方两段式内容”。右下角放置小型页码“04”。底部边缘居中处添加一个轮播指示器，包含 7 个小圆点，其中第 4 个圆点为短深色圆角胶囊状，表示当前页面，其余 6 个为浅灰色圆点。在右下角边缘添加微弱的导航提示：“← → 翻页 ESC 关闭”。使用清晰的矢量文本渲染、低调的对比度、优雅的间距，以及适合 AI 平台对比与 API 记忆锁定商业演示的冷静高端信息图表风格。

items.title: 写实海报宇宙工作室
items.promptZh: 将主底盘或结构平台完美居中作为核心脊柱，并单独定位主体外壳（左侧或顶部），平行对齐作为参考形式，同时保留真实车辆的精确比例、姿态和几何形状。￼ 设计一个多层分解系统，其中组件在深度（Z 轴）和平面间距上分离，使用清晰的层次结构：微硬件（螺栓、螺钉、垫圈）紧密分组，功能组件间隔适度，主要系统广泛分离。￼ 将零件组织成真实的子系统取决于{argument name="vehicle type" default="vehicle"}类型，包括前总成（悬架、转向、制动器）、后总成（悬架、动力传动系统、差速器）、底盘/结构（车架、硬壳式车身、副车架）、动力总成（具有轻微内部暴露的发动机或电机、变速箱、进气、排气、冷却）、电子设备（电池、ECU、具有干净布线的线束）和车轮系统（4个车轮与轮胎对称放置， ￼ 通过保留机械关系、对齐轴和旋转轴、保持左/右系统的对称性以及在精确的微网格排列中在其装配点附近对微组件进行逻辑分组来确保工程现实性。避免随意放置。使用精致、高端的美感：柔和的{参数名称=“背景渐变”默认=“中性渐变”}背景（白色到浅灰色或暖米色）、带有柔和顶部照明的工作室级产品照明、微妙的定向阴影和受控反射。应用真实的材料，例如拉丝金属、碳纤维、橡胶和玻璃，并具有轻微磨损，避免玩具般的饰面。保持强烈的水平对称性和受控的深度不对称性以实现视觉复杂性，并确保平衡的负空间以避免过度拥挤。以超逼真的质量进行渲染，具有锐利的边缘、宏观细节、微妙的环境光遮挡和光线追踪阴影。以 2K 或 4K 分辨率、4:5 宽高比输出。￼ ￼ 无文本、无标签、无箭头、无品牌覆盖、无风格化、无透视变形。风格关键词：F1工程分解图、豪华汽车技术海报、工业设计分解、苹果式产品可视化、超精密机械布局、博物馆级演示。￼
items.prompt: Place the primary chassis or structural platform perfectly centered as the core spine, and position the main body shell separately (left or top), aligned parallel as a reference form while preserving accurate proportions, stance, and geometry of the real vehicle.￼ Design a multi-layered exploded system with components separated across depth (Z-axis) as well as planar spacing, using clear hierarchy: micro hardware (bolts, screws, washers) tightly grouped, functional assemblies moderately spaced, and major systems widely separated.￼ Organize parts into realistic subsystems depending on the {argument name="vehicle type" default="vehicle"} type, including front assembly (suspension, steering, brakes), rear assembly (suspension, drivetrain, differential), chassis/structure (frame, monocoque, subframes), powertrain (engine or motor with slight internal exposure, transmission, intake, exhaust, cooling), electronics (battery, ECU, wiring harness with clean routing), and wheel systems (4 wheels symmetrically placed with tire, rim, and hub separation).￼ Ensure engineering realism by preserving mechanical relationships, aligning shafts and rotational axes, maintaining symmetry across left/right systems, and grouping micro components logically near their assembly points in precise micro-grid arrangements. Avoid random placement. Use a refined, high-end aesthetic: soft {argument name="background gradient" default="neutral gradient"} background (white to light grey or warm beige), studio-grade product lighting with soft top illumination, subtle directional shadows, and controlled reflections. Apply realistic materials such as brushed metal, carbon fiber, rubber, and glass with slight wear—avoid toy-like finishes. Maintain strong horizontal symmetry with controlled depth asymmetry for visual complexity, and ensure balanced negative space to avoid overcrowding. Render in ultra-realistic quality with razor-sharp edges, macro-level detail, subtle ambient occlusion, and ray-traced shadows. Output in 2K or 4K resolution, 4:5 aspect ratio.￼ ￼ No text, no labels, no arrows, no branding overlays, no stylization, no perspective distortion. Style keywords: F1 engineering exploded diagram, luxury automotive technical poster, industrial design breakdown, Apple-style product visualization, ultra-precision mechanical layout, museum-grade presentation.￼

排版布局
创作一种大胆的现代编辑级排版构图。
将大号品牌名称置于产品后方，使产品自然地遮挡部分文字。
在产品下方使用较小的粗体字体放置产品名称。
将价格置于产品名称下方，作为次要视觉焦点。
根据上传的产品自动生成一句简短的商业引语。
保持充裕的留白、强烈的视觉层级和高级的广告平衡感。
输出风格
高级商业海报、极简编辑设计、简洁构图、大胆排版、真实产品保留、写实光影、细腻的自然阴影、印刷级质量。

items.promptZh:
使用 Hasselblad X2D 100C 和 XCD 90mm f/2.5 镜头拍摄的高品质专业人像。一位美丽的年轻东亚女性站在明亮简约的艺术画廊里，她留着自然的深棕色长发，波浪形的柔软松散。她有着精致优雅的面部结构，白皙的皮肤，微妙而光泽的肤色，富有表现力的黑眼睛，以及精致的粉红色嘴唇。她穿着一件干净、简约的白色 T 恤，上面有大胆的黑色无衬线字体，上面写着“YOUR MINE”。她用一只手轻轻地触碰下巴，做出一种放松、深思熟虑的姿势——柔软的下巴托。背景是一幅大型抽象画，采用柔和的米色和奶油色色调，温暖的自然光穿过天窗。逼真的风格，敏锐的眼睛焦点，高度细致的皮肤纹理，可见的毛孔，微妙的自然水分，没有美颜滤镜。轻微胶片颗粒，边缘有细微色差。一条流浪猫的尾巴卷曲在左下角雕塑的底部附近。
荷兰角，流浪猫尾巴 --ar 9:16

items.title: 清晨叼面包奔跑少女
items.prompt:
主題：
朝の急ぎ足

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌に、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだ自然な肌理。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、透け感のあるピンクベージュのリップ。瞳には小さなキャッチライト。トーストを口にくわえ、少し慌てながらも明るい表情で階段を駆け下りている。

服装・ポーズ：
白い半袖のセーラー風ブラウス、上品なネイビーの襟と袖ライン、大きめで形のきれいなネイビーリボン。高めのウエストで整ったネイビーのプリーツスカート、白いソックス、黒のローファー。人物の右足は下の段へ踏み出し、左足は後ろへ軽く跳ね上がる。人物の左手でバッグのストラップを握り、右手は髪の近くで小さく上がっている。スカートと髪が走る勢いで自然に揺れる。

背景・光：
駅前にある歩道橋の階段。金属の手すり、屋根のある通路、奥にぼけた駅案内や街の看板。朝の強い日差しが画面右上から入り、顔、ブラウス、脚、階段の端を明るく照らす。階段には手すりの影が斜めに落ち、明るい部分と影の部分のコントラストをはっきり出す。空気に少しだけ白い光のにじみを入れる。

構図・カメラ：
縦長2:3、全身が入る構図。人物を中央やや右に配置し、階段と手すりの線で奥行きを作る。カメラはやや低め、正面から少し見上げる角度。人物にピントを合わせ、背景は自然にぼかす。走っている一瞬を止めたようなスナップ写真。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな日系ストリートフォト。明るい夏の朝、柔らかなハイライト、自然な肌の質感、髪一本一本の流れが見える繊細な描写。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン、薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下のミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、走る動きでふわっと広がる。バッグは濃いブラウンの日本風スクールバッグで、テディベア、小さな白いぬいぐるみ、リボン、ふわふわのキーホルダー、ビーズチャームを複数吊るす。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、浮いた足、重力に合わない髪やスカート、バッグの飾りの崩れ、道具との接触不良、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、不要な人物。

items.title: 暗夜暖光守岸人写真
items.prompt:
20岁东方成年女性cosplay模特，扮演角色守岸人（鸣潮），近距离复古暗光人像，保留角色原本的发型、发色、瞳色、脸部特征、气质与核心识别点，将角色转化为夜晚暖光胶片写真风格。角色处于极暗环境中，背景几乎全黑，画面只由一束强烈的暖黄色橙色侧光照亮。光线从画面左侧或左前方直射，照亮角色的额头、发丝、半张脸、鼻梁、嘴唇、肩颈和锁骨，另一半脸自然隐入深黑阴影，形成高反差、半明半暗的电影感。

角色表情安静、迷离、脆弱、略带倦怠，眼神可以直视镜头或轻轻看向光源方向，嘴唇自然放松，整体情绪像夜晚独处时被光捕捉到的瞬间。发丝自然凌乱，额前有碎发，部分发丝被暖光照成金色边缘，带有被风吹起或随意拨开的动态感。人物肩颈放松，构图为竖屏近景或半身近景，脸部占据画面中心，肩膀与锁骨进入画面，镜头距离近，带有私密自拍感和旧照片抓拍感。

角色服装可保留原设，也可以替换为简洁吊带、细肩带上衣、轻薄睡衣、复古连衣裙或符合角色设定的日常化服装。服装材质偏柔软、哑光、自然贴身，颜色可以使用深绿色、墨绿色、黑色、白色、米色或角色主题色。

画面色彩以黑色暗部、暖橙高光、焦糖肤色、金棕发丝、低饱和服装色为主。整体有复古胶片、CCD 暗光自拍、低清数码摄影、柔焦、轻微过曝和暗部颗粒质感。画面允许保留适度胶片颗粒和暗光噪点来强化复古氛围，但主体脸部、眼睛、发丝边缘、肩颈轮廓保持稳定可读。光影自然，亮部柔和扩散，暗部深沉，背景简洁干净，没有复杂场景干扰。

整体画面干净清晰，减少无必要的脏乱感，粒子特效克制，避免大面积漂浮颗粒、碎光和杂质感；如果手部出现在画面中，手部结构自然准确，手指数量正确，比例正常，关节清晰，姿态合理。整体细节稳定，保留暗夜暖光、复古胶片、私密脆弱、迷离安静的情绪氛围。

items.title: 极简女性
items.prompt:
Create a clean vertical 2:3 animation model-sheet character card for [角色全名], redesigned as a clearly adult or age-neutral safe character profile sheet depending on the source. The page should look like a polished official anime design reference page, not a sexy poster.

AUTO-ADAPT FROM CHARACTER: infer source work, iconic hairstyle, face shape, expression, costume colors, emblem, accessories, props, and personality keywords. Preserve recognizability while simplifying details into a clean production-ready design.

PAGE LAYOUT: large clean title at top, small source subtitle, front close-up portrait, full-body front standing pose, full-body back-facing standing pose, side-view or three-quarter pose, small action pose, expression thumbnails, color palette swatches, close-up boxes for hair, collar, sleeve, shoes, emblem, weapon or prop, and concise handwritten annotation arrows. White grid-paper background, clear margins, thin blue-gray construction lines, organized labels.

POSE SET: front close-up, confident front stand, back-facing stand, side three-quarter stand, small seated hugging raised shins pose or relaxed prop-holding pose. Avoid low-angle sexualized framing.

STYLE: clean anime model sheet, crisp line art, flat-to-soft cel shading, readable silhouette, controlled colors, production reference quality, official artbook layout.

Safety: tasteful, fully clothed, non-explicit, no nudity, no body-part focus, no erotic framing. If the source character is underage, keep the design completely non-sexual and age-neutral.

items.title: 古建微缩蓝图模型
items.prompt:
请生成一张竖版 2:3 高清图片，主题为《建筑微缩蓝图》。

建筑名称：[填写具体建筑]

画面是一张现代建筑设计手稿，上面布满中文平面图、剖面图、立面图、结构细节图、尺寸标注和施工说明。一座高度仿真的中国古建筑微缩模型，从图纸中立体“建”出来。

主建筑要占画面 65%–75%，更大、更高、更有视觉冲击力。使用低角度 3/4 俯视视角，突出模型高度、体积感和真实阴影。建筑要符合所选主题的真实特征，并呈现正在施工中的状态，完成度约 70%–85%。

加入微缩施工细节：施工小人、脚手架、木架、坡道、滑轮、木梁、石块、瓦片、材料堆、小推车、马车、半完成台阶、屋顶施工区等。细节要围绕建筑本身展开，形成一个仿真的微缩建造世界。

整体风格是现代建筑事务所概念提案板 + 博物馆级微缩模型。图纸干净高级，颜色以米白、浅灰、淡蓝、灰黑线稿为主。所有文字必须是中文，主标题写“[建筑名称]”，副标题写“建筑营造过程示意图”。

使用柔和中性光线，画面清晰、现代、克制、有高级感。避免复古黄、羊皮纸、古董感、杂乱工作室、书本、蜡烛、卷轴、尺子、指南针、桌面摆件、现代机械、现代车辆和无关背景。

最终效果：让一座中国古建筑像从现代设计图纸里真实建造出来，兼具建筑学专业感、微缩模型趣味和强烈视觉冲击力。

使用与[产品名称]相匹配的视觉丰富的背景，其颜色灵感来自于产品本身。添加抽象形状、平滑渐变、流动波浪图案、产品后面的圆形亮点、浮动成分元素、装饰箭头、有趣的图形强调以及干净的现代海报风格的布置。保持作品充满活力、优质且适合社交媒体。

items.title: 龙3D信息图山城市
items.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="country name" default="中国"} 创建一份简洁、现代的国家概况信息图，标题为“中国国家概况”，中心放置大型 3D 浮雕地图，周围环绕统计数据卡片。

画布：16:9 横向信息图，浅灰色背景，清晰的企业编辑风格，柔和的阴影，红/蓝/绿强调色，高分辨率矢量与 3D 结合的外观。

主地图：在中心放置一张大型 3D 地形浮雕地图，占据画布大部分空间。使用地形配色：西部为橙褐色山脉，中部为黄色高原，东部和沿海为绿色低地。添加白色省界和黑色省份标签。将台湾、海南和南海诸岛作为独立的浮雕部分包含在内。在中心处放置醒目的黑色大写字母“CHINA”。用红色星号标记北京并标注。地图标签应准确包含 28 个省/自治区/直辖市标签：新疆、西藏、青海、甘肃、内蒙古、宁夏、四川、云南、贵州、广西、广东、海南、福建、浙江、江苏、安徽、山东、湖北、湖南、陕西、山西、北京、天津、辽宁、吉林、黑龙江、台湾和中国。

左上角标题栏：醒目的红色大标题“中国”，深色副标题“国家概况”，一条细红分割线，以及一段简短文字：“中国，全称中华人民共和国，是位于东亚的国家。它是世界上人口最多的国家，人口超过 14 亿。”

左侧统计卡片：一张圆角白色长卡片，包含 5 行堆叠的事实数据，每行配有红色圆形图标和文字。5 行内容为：人口 — {argument name="population value" default="14.1 亿"} — 世界排名：第 1；GDP（名义） — 17.79 万亿美元 — 世界排名：第 2；人均 GDP — 12,614 美元 — 世界排名：第 63；首都 — {argument name="capital city" default="北京"}；官方语言 — {argument name="official language" default="中文（普通话）"}。行与行之间使用细分割线。

右上角概况卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为红色的“概况”。包含 4 行红色图标内容：政府 — 单一制社会主义共和国；成立日期 — 1949 年 10 月 1 日；土地面积 — 960 万平方公里，世界排名：第 3；人口密度 — 约 147 人/平方公里。

中右侧经济图表卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“经济概览”，副标题为“(名义 GDP)”，并附有小标签“万亿美元”。包含 4 根垂直柱状图，分别代表 2020、2021、2022、2023 年，数值分别为 14.72、16.86、17.96、17.79。2020–2022 年使用蓝色柱状，2023 年使用红色柱状。

左下角产业卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“产业构成 (按 GDP)”。包含 3 部分组成的环形图：蓝色代表工业 39.7%，红色代表服务业 53.2%，绿色代表农业 7.1%。添加带有相同 3 个标签和百分比的图例。

底部中心出口卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“主要出口产品 (2023 年)”。包含 5 列出口数据，配有蓝色线条图标和红色数值：电子产品 — 1.02 万亿美元；机械设备 — 0.78 万亿美元；纺织服装 — 0.31 万亿美元；汽车产品 — 0.26 万亿美元；化学产品 — 0.23 万亿美元。

右下角贸易伙伴卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“主要贸易伙伴 (按贸易总额)”。包含 5 条蓝色水平柱状图，配有小型旗帜图标和数值：美国 — 6640 亿美元；欧盟 — 6430 亿美元；东盟 — 5960 亿美元；中国香港 — 2650 亿美元；日本 — 2270 亿美元。

页脚：居中放置一行小字来源说明：“数据来源：世界银行、世界贸易组织、中国国家统计局。”

约束条件：所有卡片需围绕地图排列且互不重叠，使用统一的字体，红色标题，蓝色图表元素，柔和的投影，圆角卡片，且不得添加水印。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
创作一幅竖幅肖像，宽高比约为3:4，具有2000年代末或2010年代初直闪数码照片的视觉特征。一名22至30岁的成年女性站在昏暗、华丽的古典室内，位置接近画面中央但略偏画面左侧。从头顶到小腿下部或裙摆中下部构图，双脚不入镜。她身形高挑、纤细、骨架窄小，脖颈和肩线修长。重心主要落在一条腿上，髋部向画面右侧偏移，双肩向相反方向倾斜，形成自然拉长的S形曲线。

她在画面左侧的手臂抬起并弯曲，手轻轻触碰后脑或头发。画面右侧的手臂沿髋部线条向下，手指柔和弯曲。姿态应显得优雅，但不要标准化或完美排练过。保留动作刚刚停下的偶然紧张感，仿佛下一刻她就会放下抬起的手。这不是镜面自拍；画面中不出现手机，左右构图不得翻转。

保留小巧的椭圆脸、柔和的下颌线、纤细鼻梁和自然丰满的嘴唇。她的眼睛略微睁大，平静地聚焦在镜头附近，嘴唇保持自然闭合或几乎微张。她没有刻意微笑。表情安静、警觉且带着细微疲惫，带有正式晚宴将尽时的情感疏离感。

使用受东亚正式晚宴和红毯美学影响的精致妆容：暖中性白皙肤色，薄而半哑光的底妆，仍可见真实皮肤纹理，自然深色眉毛，低饱和灰褐色与灰粉紫红色眼影，细眼线，轻睫毛膏，低饱和粉色腮红轻扫，以及有光泽的裸粉或玫瑰米色唇妆。她长而黑或黑棕色的头发从面部向后梳起，露出耳朵，太阳穴附近有几缕自然飞散的碎发。添加长款银调水钻或水晶流苏耳环，在颈旁捕捉闪光。

让她穿着协调的香槟粉调晚礼服。上半身是高领无袖或挂脖式半透视网纱胸衣，颜色为低饱和香槟粉、裸杏色、浅玫瑰色和暖米色。细密亮片覆盖网纱，在直闪下产生零散的银白色闪光和偶尔的高光溢出。胸部仍明显被半透视面料覆盖；不要渲染为裸露或完全透明。画面右侧腰部有一个小的不对称侧开衩，只露出从侧腰向上髋方向的一小条皮肤。

下装是高位及地缎面鱼尾裙或修身直筒裙，颜色为柔和腮红粉、灰玫瑰色或珠光玫瑰米色。腰部和髋部周围加入斜向垂褶和自然聚拢的褶皱。面料贴合髋部和大腿，然后向下收窄并超出画面。缎面应看起来柔软、冷滑、略带垂坠感，并带有闪光造成的不规则竖向高光。

清晰展示面部、颈部、锁骨、双肩、双臂、抬起手臂下方腋下附近区域、手指，以及画面右侧侧腰和上髋的一小段裸露皮肤。皮肤为暖中性白皙，在冷白闪光下略显瓷感，同时在阴影中保留柔和桃色血色。应显得细腻、柔软、微暖，触摸时有淡淡水润感。保留毛孔、细微色调差异、轻微关节纹理，以及额头、鼻梁、颧骨、锁骨和上臂上真实的油光高光。避免蜡感磨皮或塑料皮肤。

使用靠近镜头轴线的硬质正面机顶直闪作为主光。它直接照亮面部、肩部、手臂、亮片胸衣和缎面裙中央，然后沿身体两侧迅速衰减。在主体身后形成硬阴影，深色木材中形成近黑色区域，亮片上出现突兀的白色高光。背景仅由微弱琥珀色钨丝灯或暖环境光照亮，在闪光灯照亮的皮肤与桃橙色房间之间形成清晰的冷暖分离。几盏暖灯的反光出现在覆盖画作的玻璃上，漆面家具捕捉到零散高光。不要加入柔光箱、轮廓光、均衡补光或电影式三点布光。

将她置于类似老酒店、私人餐厅、会员俱乐部或古典装饰住宅的华丽室内。使用暖桃橙色肌理墙面，天花板附近有镀金雕花边框。画面左侧包含大面积近黑色木饰板或深色立柱。在画面右侧主体身后，挂一幅带玻璃罩面的东亚山水或园林风格画作，上面有数个暖色反光点。她腰部后方有深色光亮漆面桌或柜，右下背景有带图案软包的深色木椅，下部墙面有深色护墙板或类似壁炉的结构。

照片处理应类似带内置闪光灯的紧凑型消费数码相机或早期智能手机，合理使用35–45mm全画幅等效焦距，约f/2.8–f/4，以及约1/60–1/100秒。相机位于胸部到腰部高度，接近平视但略带仰视透视。构图轻微偏移，允许建筑垂直线保持不完全校正。保留轻微高ISO颗粒、JPEG压缩、细节略软、暗部压死、亮片高光溢出和曝光不均。背景仍可辨认但比主体柔和；避免极浅景深。

闪光灯亮起时房间已经暗下来。她正抬起一只手整理头发，就在离开晚宴前，被捕捉到不到一秒的瞬间；下一刻姿态就会松弛。成片应像多年后重新发现的私人旧数码照片——华丽、安静、略带醉意、情绪未决，人的不完美比商业化的完美更重要。

负面提示：镜面自拍，手持手机，水平翻转，影棚柔光箱，电影感轮廓光，日光，现代白色房间，塑料皮肤，重度磨皮，夸张曲线，过大胸部，极细腰，过长腿，完全透明衣物，裸体，僵硬对称姿势，极端散景，多余手指，畸形手，抬起的手臂扭曲，重复耳环，过度锐化，CGI，动漫，文字，水印。
items.prompt:
Create a vertical portrait in an approximately 3:4 aspect ratio with the visual character of a late-2000s or early-2010s direct-flash digital photograph. An adult woman around 22 to 30 years old stands in a dim, ornate classical interior, positioned near the center but slightly toward image-left. Frame her from the top of the head to the lower calf or mid-lower skirt, leaving the feet outside the image. She has a tall, slender, narrow-framed silhouette with an elongated neck and shoulders. Her weight rests mainly on one leg, her hip shifts toward image-right, and her shoulders tilt in the opposite direction, forming a natural elongated S-curve.

Her arm on image-left is lifted and bent, with the hand lightly touching the back of her head or her hair. Her arm on image-right follows the hip line downward, with gently curved fingers. The pose should feel elegant but not standardized or perfectly rehearsed. Preserve the accidental tension of a movement that has just paused, as though she will lower the raised hand in the next moment. This is not a mirror selfie; no phone is visible, and the left-right composition must not be flipped.

Preserve a small oval face, soft jawline, slender nose bridge, and naturally full lips. Her eyes are slightly widened and calmly focused near the lens, while the lips remain naturally closed or barely parted. She is not smiling deliberately. Her expression is quiet, alert, and subtly tired, carrying the emotional distance of a formal evening that is almost over.

Use refined makeup informed by East Asian formal-dinner and red-carpet aesthetics: warm-neutral fair skin, a thin semi-matte complexion base with real skin texture still visible, naturally dark brows, muted taupe and dusty mauve-pink eyeshadow, fine eyeliner, light mascara, softly placed low-saturation pink blush, and glossy nude-pink or rose-beige lips. Her long black or black-brown hair is brushed back from the face, leaving the ears visible, with a few natural flyaway strands near the temples. Add long silver-toned rhinestone or crystal tassel earrings that catch the flash beside the neck.

Dress her in a coordinated champagne-blush evening gown. The upper section is a high-neck sleeveless or halter-style semi-sheer mesh bodice in muted champagne pink, nude apricot, pale rose, and warm beige. Fine sequins cover the mesh and produce scattered silver-white sparkles and occasional clipped highlights under direct flash. The chest remains visibly covered by the semi-sheer textile; do not render it as bare or completely transparent. Include a small asymmetrical side opening at the waist on image-right, revealing only a limited strip of skin from the side waist toward the upper hip.

The lower garment is a high-waisted floor-length satin mermaid or fitted column skirt in soft blush pink, dusty rose, or pearlescent rose-beige. Add diagonal draping and naturally gathered folds around the waist and hips. The fabric follows the hips and thighs before narrowing downward beyond the frame. The satin should look soft, cool, slippery, and slightly weighty, with irregular vertical highlights produced by the flash.

Clearly show the face, neck, collarbones, both shoulders, both arms, the area near the underarm beneath the raised arm, the fingers, and the small exposed section of side waist and upper hip on image-right. The skin is warm-neutral and fair, becoming slightly porcelain under the cool-white flash while retaining soft peach blood tone in the shadows. It should appear fine, soft, gently warm, and faintly dewy to the touch. Preserve pores, subtle tonal differences, light joint texture, and realistic oily highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbones, and upper arms. Avoid waxy smoothing or plastic skin.

Use a hard frontal on-camera flash positioned very close to the lens axis as the dominant light. It directly illuminates the face, shoulders, arms, sequined bodice, and center of the satin skirt, then falls off rapidly along the sides of the body.
